title: Construction Compliance Analyst
description:
About Us: Consertus is an AI-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep industry expertise with advanced digital capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,400 professionals, we help clients plan, deliver, and optimize complex capital programs across the full project lifecycle. Our integrated capabilities span advisory, digital solutions, engineering and design, and program delivery, enabling organizations to navigate complexity, mitigate risk, and achieve strategic objectives. We serve a diverse range of industries, including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial real estate, life sciences, and technology. At Consertus, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, flexible, and inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop their skills, and make a meaningful impact. Together, we're transforming the way the world is planned, built, and delivered. Learn more about how Consertus is creating lasting value for clients, communities, and our people at . About this Role: The Senior Construction Auditor is responsible for performing detailed reviews and analyses of construction applications for payment and professional service invoices on assigned projects and programs. This role focuses on verifying that billed costs are accurate, properly supported, and compliant with contract requirements, applicable policies, and established invoice review and exception-handling procedures. The Senior Construction Auditor/Compliance Analyst works in a dynamic, multi-vendor environment and supports projects delivered under various construction project delivery approaches. This position requires a solid understanding of construction contracts and invoice processing, along with the ability to identify, document, and communicate compliance issues effectively. Key Responsibilities: 
 Follow established invoice review procedures, instructions, and exception-handling processes. 
 Read, interpret, and understand construction contract provisions related to invoice processing and payment, translating contract requirements into actionable compliance testing. 
 Demonstrate a working understanding of various contract structures and associated cost controls. 
 Verify that each invoice has all required contractual authorizations prior to approval. 
 Understand the scope of work associated with the construction project being billed and assess whether invoiced costs align with approved scope. 
 Review invoices across multiple vendors and contracts, effectively managing complex and high-volume review environments. 
 Establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients and vendors to facilitate communication and timely resolution of issues identified during the invoice review process. 
 Identify non-compliance issues and clearly document findings and associated cost impacts in a concise and accurate manner. 
 Describe identified issues and request appropriate corrective actions in accordance with established procedures. 
 Maintain complete and well-organized electronic and paper work papers documenting review procedures, findings, reviewed amounts, and payment recommendations. 
 Create, manipulate, and analyze spreadsheets to support invoice reviews, reconciliations, and tracking. 
 Maintain accurate and timely invoice tracking logs to support payment workflows and reporting. 
 Work independently while exercising sound professional judgment, and seek appropriate guidance and clarification when needed. 
 Collaborate effectively with other members of the audit and project team to ensure consistent application of review procedures. 
 Qualifications/Requirements: 
 Minimum of five (5) years of experience reviewing and/or processing construction invoices or payment applications. 
 Construction contract compliance experience. 
 Previous knowledge of the construction industry. 
 Experience with all construction project delivery methods. 
 Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and inconsistencies. 
 Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate complex cost and contract information. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document and explain findings. 
 Strong professional customer service skills and ability to work effectively with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders. 
 What’s In It For You: 
 Company-paid life and disability insurance 
 Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans 
 401(k) with day-one eligibility. You’ll get a 100% match on the first 3% of your eligible compensation and 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5% of your pay. 
 Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25 
 Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development 
 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status. title: Platform Tester (Back-end Systems) - Canada
description: As a Platform Tester, you'll safeguard the quality of the core platform behind Intelerad 's medical imaging solutions: the services, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure that healthcare providers rely on every day. Building on a strong testing foundation, you'll own test strategy for platform components, expand automated coverage across back-end and integration layers, and partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams. Together you'll make sure every release is stable, scalable, and ready for clinical environments. Key Responsibilities Platform Test Strategy: Own test planning and execution for assigned platform components and services. Define coverage across functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing to reduce release risk. Automation & CI/CD Integration: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, services, and back-end systems. Integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence. Integration & Non-Functional Testing: Validate platform behaviour across interfaces and deployment environments. This includes interoperability (e.g., DICOM, HL7), performance, scalability, and upgrade and migration scenarios. Defect Analysis & Resolution: Investigate complex, cross-component issues using logs, data, and system diagnostics to isolate root causes. Partner with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence. Quality Practice & Mentorship: Contribute to platform testing standards and quality metrics. Guide Software Testers on platform testing approaches, tooling, and best practices. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance, including experience testing integrated, multi-service, or platform-level systems, or equivalent experience. Demonstrated experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks for API and integration testing. Working knowledge of SQL, test management tooling (e.g., qTest, Zephyr), and CI/CD pipelines. Experience testing within containerized or cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). Demonstrated ability to lead test strategy for complex releases with minimal supervision. Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements Experience with performance and load testing tools for distributed systems. Healthcare IT or medical imaging domain knowledge (e.g., PACS, RIS, DICOM) is a plus. ISTQB certification or equivalent. This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.  The base pay for this position ranges from $75,000yr - 100,000/yr CAD within any geographic market in Canada. title: Cloud Architect
description:
We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed 's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support 
 Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives 
 Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments 
 Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies. 
 Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly. 
 • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them. 
 Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed 's cloud standards and updating those standards where required 
 Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them. 
 Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant. 
 Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time. 
 Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions 
 Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested 
 Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning 
 Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design 
 **Required Qualifications:** 
 Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments. 
 Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role 
 Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security. 
 Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM). 
 Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor 
 Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards. 
 Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence. 
 Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences. 
 Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems. 
 **Preferred Qualifications:** 
 Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures 
 Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms 
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 
 Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles 
 Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns 
 Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects 
 When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting. We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here. 
 Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve. 
 Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard. 
 Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

 Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together. 
 We look forward to welcoming your application. Medicine moves forward here. So will you. Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose. Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world. The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives. Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Mainframe Systems Programmer - DB2 Physical
description:
At Ensono , our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose. HONESTY, RELIABILITY, COLLABORATION, CURIOSITY, PASSION Role Summary Provide premium DB2 sysprog support and services to Ensono mainframe clients as they relate to Mainframe DB2 systems. The successful candidate will perform mainframe database software upgrades coupled with administration and tuning to support our customers’ DB2 environments. The individual will need to work with vendor personnel to achieve timely solutions of database problems. The individual will be responsible for day-to-day database maintenance such as creating backups, performing restores, monitoring file extent growth, scheduling reorganizations, creating and maintaining DR procedures and overall support of customer needs and requests. The successful candidate will be called upon to perform a variety of database optimizations that will include general reporting and analysis of the efficiency of the database configuration and periodic review of database performance. What You Will Do: Expertise and work efforts will focus on the development and support and/or the customization of new services and support efforts. System programming knowledge of multiple DBMS’s is a bonus. The individual will need to participate in on-call responsibilities. Fulfill customer service orders (CSOs) for mainframe z/OS customers in a timely manner as they pertain to DB2 Provide primary support for reported problems related to DB2 tables spaces Provide support on 24 x 7 x 365 basis across multiple time zones. Provide key support for customer migration services (new customer transitions) as they pertain to DB2 and related OEM software products. Assist the assigned project manager in the migration of newly acquired customers such that all technical hurdles are addressed in a timely manner and do not impede the expected progress of the transition nor the targeted migration date. In joint cooperation with the Disaster Recovery Services, successfully execute tasks associated with any given customer’s disaster recovery plans. Adhere to a schedule that efficiently manages resources and allows timely implementations. Follow ITSM change control procedures We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono . That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.   What You Will Need: Bachelor’s degree required and/or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of professional experience in DB2 for administration and systems programming support. Knowledgeable in best practices of software management, maintenance and documentation SMP/e experience Experience with configuring and managing DB2 in a parallel sysplex environment Ability to develop innovation, strategies, processes and best practices in software management Experience with establishing policies and procedures pertaining to database management, DR, security, maintenance, and utilization Experience with reviewing new versions of DB2 for functionality, advising how they benefit the client Ability to evaluate change requests and determine impact to assigned clients and troubleshooting and solving production database issues. Experience with supporting DB2 security requests Ability to review DB2 security to find potential risks Experience with reorganization of application data Experience with reviewing, tuning of internal DB2 buffer pools and SQL code Demonstrated ability to respond quickly and effectively to support requests from multiple clients Supporting multiple customer for after hours on-call Other Qualifications 
 IDAA, CA and IBM tools for DB2 are a plus 
 Self-motivated and able to work independently. 
 Demonstrated ability to respond quickly and effectively to support requests from multiple clients Must be able to multi-task and work under short deadlines and in high pressure situations. Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentations) Ability to work as part of a team, as well as independently. Why Ensono ? Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it. We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices. Some of our benefits include: Unlimited Paid Days Off Three health plan options 401k with company match Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement Paid childbearing and paternal leave Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding Sabbatical leave Wellness program Flexible work schedule As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $65,000 to $123,000 salary, based on a fulltime schedule. title: Director of Growth
description:
About Scale Media For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding. Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands. We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact. Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company. If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in. The Role We're looking for a Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition team and raise the bar on performance across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands. We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers. You'll bring deep platform expertise and the drive to be in the numbers every day: reading performance, spotting what changed and why, and working with the team on what to do about it. You'll set the standard for how we buy media, make sure every platform gets clean, complete data, and make our media buyers sharper every week. You'll also allocate budget across channels against the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets we set. This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be setting up campaigns or launching ads yourself, but you'll be in the accounts daily, diagnosing problems and helping make the calls on account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing. You'll work closely with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics, and help us build AI-enabled workflows that make our media buying faster and sharper. You'll report to the VP of Growth. What You'll Own 
 
 Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands and channels, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them. 
 
 Leading the paid acquisition team. Managing and developing our media buyers: reviewing accounts with them, pressure-testing decisions, and building their judgment. 
 
 Media buying standards. Setting and raising the bar on how we buy Meta and paid social: account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing. 
 
 Platform data quality. Making sure we send the right data into every platform: pixels and Conversions API firing correctly, the right event parameters, and audience exclusions set up properly. 
 
 Landing pages, creative, and copy. Working with media buyers, Creative, and Ecommerce to decide which pages to launch and where creative and copy need to improve. 
 
 Budget allocation. Allocating and pacing budget across paid channels to hit the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets set with the VP of Growth. 
 
 Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across audiences, offers, landing pages, and campaign settings, and turning results into clear next moves. 
 
 Performance reads. Working with Analytics to read performance through MTA and lift testing, and acting on what the results show. 
 
 AI-enabled workflows. Using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, creative tagging, and optimization. 
 
 Agencies and vendors. Managing agency or vendor support where relevant. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level efficiency targets 
 Scaled Meta and paid social spend across brands 
 A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks 
 Clean, consistent account structures that are easier to scale and diagnose 
 Reliable platform data, with no pixel/CAPI event or audience gaps 
 A media buying team that makes stronger decisions on its own 
 Faster testing velocity, with a clear backlog and documented learnings 
 A higher hit rate on new landing pages, creative, and copy 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Deep Meta and paid social expertise. You've personally managed 8-figure Meta spend for consumer brands, know the platform inside out, and have a playbook on how to scale without losing efficiency that adapts as the platform evolves. 
 
 Drive to be in the numbers every day. You look at performance daily because you want to, you notice when something moves, and you don't rest until you understand and address it. 
 
 People leadership. You've managed media buyers and made them measurably better through direct feedback, account reviews, and clear standards. 
 
 Tracking fluency. You understand pixels, Conversions API, event parameters, and audience exclusions well enough to spot problems and specify fixes. 
 
 Cross-channel budget experience. You've allocated budget across more than one paid channel and can make tradeoffs between them. 
 
 Conversion and creative judgment. You can look at a landing page, ad, or piece of copy and say specifically what will improve performance. 
 
 Testing discipline. You design clean tests, read results honestly, and know when a learning is real. 
 
 Analytical strength. You're comfortable working through performance data, attribution gaps, and the limits of platform-reported numbers. 
 
 AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution. 
 
 Cross-functional partnership. You work well with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics without adding unnecessary process. 
 7–10 years of relevant experience, including managing media buyers. 
 Strong candidate backgrounds include: 
 Meta or paid social leads at scaled DTC brands 
 Senior media buyers who have managed a team of buyers 
 Agency paid social leads who've run large ecommerce accounts 
 Preferred, but Not Required 
 Experience with TikTok or other paid social channels 
 Hands-on Google Search, YouTube, and Performance Max experience 
 Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses 
 Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios 
 What We Offer 
 
 Salary: $140,000–$200,000, depending on experience 
 Excellent medical, dental, vision, and life insurance 
 Fully remote, full-time position 
 Monthly WFH stipend 
 Generous paid time off program 
 Discounted products

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
About AMZ Advisers : AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning. About the Role: We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career. The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success. This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff. What You’ll Do: General Responsibilities 
 Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate. 
 Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication. 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times. 
 Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account. 
 Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities. 
 Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management. 
 Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement. 
 Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions. 
 Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising. 
 Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way. 
 Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy. 
 Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed. 
 Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development. 
 Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals. 
 Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis. 
 Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum. 
 Strategy Ownership 
 Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies. 
 Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas. 
 Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity. 
 Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives. 
 Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client. 
 Advertising & Amazon Knowledge 
 Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics. 
 Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication. 
 Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy. 
 Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share. 
 Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes. 
 Pod Collaboration 
 Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed. 
 Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions. 
 Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated. 
 Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early. 
 Client Communication & Relationship Management 
 Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients. 
 Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next. 
 Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism. 
 Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting. 
 Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided. 
 Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience. 
 Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues. 
 Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities 
 Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early. 
 Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate. 
 Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items. 
 Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience. 
 How We’ll Measure Success 
 Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month. 
 Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers. 
 Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions. 
 Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics. 
 Qualifications: 
 BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies. 
 2+ years with client account management. 
 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience. 
 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central. 
 Ability to build and maintain client relations. 
 Active listening and the ability to understand client needs. 
 Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently. 
 Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies. 
 Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask. 
 Ability and desire to learn new skills. 
 Technologies We Use: 
 G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides 
 Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 
 ClickUp 
 Nordpass 
 Slack 
 Sellerboard 
 Data Dive 
 Zoom 
 To Apply Please Include the Following: 
 Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered) 
 Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work 
 Answers to the following questions: 
 Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central. 
 Do you have any experience leading a team? 
 Why are you interested in a new job/ this position? 
 Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

title: Business Development Manager - Global, Remote (UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS)
description:
About Magic 
 
 Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley, and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training. 
 Role Purpose 
 We are seeking experienced and driven Business Development Managers (Account Executives) who are passionate about helping fast-growing businesses achieve their goals. As a BDM, you will own the end-to-end sales cycle—from initial outreach and discovery to closing and onboarding—while consistently creating value and fostering lasting client relationships. We will give you 50+ warm inbound leads per month. Your job? Own them. All the way. From discovery to close, from "not now" to "let's revisit", your success will come from your grit, discipline, curiosity, and accountability. We're looking for high-performing Account Executives who are obsessed with results, coachable to the core, and treat every lead like gold. 
 Key Areas of Impact and Focus: 
 
 
 Core Responsibilities: 
 
 Own the full sales cycle from inbound discovery to follow-up, closing, and successful onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition for new clients and hitting quota monthly 
 
 Run 15+ discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects; uncover pain, establish urgency, and align the right product 
 
 Know when to position which Magic product by becoming a true product expert and match offerings to prospect needs with precision 
 
 Treat every lead like a win waiting to happen by working “not now” leads with discipline and creativity until the timing is right 
 
 Work every deal to completion and don’t let momentum die; follow up persistently, update next steps, and never lose track of potential 
 
 Own your pipeline like a pro while keeping HubSpot clean, prioritize outreach, and maintain deal velocity at all times 
 
 Collaborate with Sales, Support, and Ops Teams to ensure clients start strong and are set up for long-term success 
 
 Share what’s working and learn what’s not bringing a growth mindset to every deal, and adapt quickly when SOPs, experiments, or strategies evolve 
 
 Continuously learn and improve, seeking feedback, applying it fast, and treating personal growth like part of the job 
 
 Stay consistent, stay hungry while showing up with energy, drive, and the mindset that every day is an opportunity to win 
 
 
 
 
 What Winning Looks Like: 
 You handle 2 to 8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball 
 You don’t let soft “no's” die. You work the deal until the answer is final 
 You actively ask, “What could I do better?” and apply the feedback fast 
 You own your pipeline like you personally paid for the lead. Every lead, every stage, is tracked and followed up on 
 You’re not waiting for opportunities, you’re creating them in your pipeline 
 
 
 
 
 Who This Role is Not For: 
 You blame the leads, the tools, or the process, rather than asking what you could do better 
 You need a manager to tell you what to do every day 
 You think leads manage themselves and don’t believe in persistent, proactive follow-up 
 You don’t take the initiative to improve; you wait for someone to tell you what to fix 
 You treat “bad timing” or “not now” as dead ends instead of future wins to nurture

 Qualification Requirements

 Mindset Fit: Hungry, gritty, coachable, self-accountable, and you take ownership of outcomes and don’t wait to be told what to fix. 
 
 Culture Fit : You thrive in a fast-changing startup, are mature, proactive, curious, and a driver of team momentum. 
 
 Tech Fluency: You’re strong with HubSpot, AI tools, and modern sales platforms, using technology to go faster. 
 Start Date: You can start on February 9, 2026

 Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to consistently work in Eastern Time, including adjustments for Daylight Saving Time 
 
 Availability: Monday to Friday, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours 
 
 
 Equipment Requirements (Self-Provided) 
 
 Computer/laptop meeting company specifications 
 Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/10 Mbps upload) 
 Professional headset for clear client communication 
 Quiet, distraction-free work environment 
 Backup power/internet solution for uninterrupted client service 
 
 
 Traits of a Top Performer at Magic Sales Team 
 
 Hunger: You chase results and hate leaving potential on the table 
 Grit: You keep pushing when it gets hard because that’s where wins happen 
 Coachability: You treat feedback like fuel 
 Maturity: You treat leads like gold and time like your most valuable asset 
 Ownership: You drive your own success; you don’t wait for it 
 Problem Solver: You look for paths forward, not reasons it won’t work 
 
 
 Application Process 
 
 Apply - Application + Video Questions

 2nd Level Interview - 1 on 1 with Sales Leadership We may have a 3rd interview with an additional sales leader 
 
 Role Play Exercise - 1 on 1 with Sales Leadership 
 Final Interview - Team-Based Interview 
 
 
 Why Top Sales Performers Choose Magic 
 
 
 Limitless Earning Potential 
 
 
 Guaranteed Base: $1,500 - $2,500 monthly foundation for stability 
 
 Performance Commission: 15-25% increasing with performance excellence

 Rapid Advancement: Clear path to senior roles with enhanced compensation

title: Product Manager
description:
About DeweyLearn 
 DeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment. We believe the most valuable knowledge in any organization doesn’t live in manuals or policies, it lives in the decisions experts make every day. Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters. DeweyLearn is an AI-powered human assessment and evaluation platform. Our multimodal system analyzes audio and video of real learning, training, and coaching sessions using observational frameworks developed with domain experts, then turns what it sees into structured insight for assessment, coaching, certification, and quality assurance. Our partners span higher education, corporate training, clinical practice, and K-12 education. DeweyLearn won the GSV Cup grand prize at the 2026 ASU+GSV Summit as the world’s best edtech startup, and recently closed a Series A led by SJF Ventures. Tasks About the role You own end-to-end product management across existing verticals, new verticals, and internal tooling. Working with the Head of Product, you take a focused approach to understanding the problem, and building, validating, launching, and improving a solution that people actually use. Use cases might include a nursing simulation workflow, a repeatable solution for an existing customer need, or an internal tool that helps our team deliver faster. This is a hands-on building role. You use agentic tools to compose existing DeweyLearn and third-party capabilities, configure workflows, and test working solutions. You partner with Customer Success and domain experts to understand the use case, and with Engineering and Product Delivery to deliver it successfully. You own the assigned product’s outcomes, then take on new opportunities as the solution becomes repeatable, and ongoing ownership is clear. Requirements What you'll do Understand the use case: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, customers, and domain experts to identify the problem, current process, and evidence of value. 
 Build the complete solution. Configure workflows, prompts, evaluation frameworks, and integrations using existing capabilities and agentic tools. Work with Engineering when platform changes are needed. 
 Validate in real use. Test the full customer or internal workflow against agreed quality criteria, review failures with relevant domain and technical owners, and iterate. 
 Launch and drive adoption. Coordinate readiness, onboarding, and handover with Product Delivery. Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing on demos, enablement, and feedback. 
 Own the outcomes. Track useful adoption, quality, time to first value, and commercial contribution. For internal tools, demonstrate time savings, improved throughput, or reduced errors. 
 Make it repeatable. Reduce bespoke setup and support, build reusable workflows, and turn user learning into product improvements and roadmap input for the Head of Product. 
 About the Candidate 
 Curiosity and adaptability: You learn new domains quickly and recognize when to involve specialists or engineers. You can move between industries and internal use cases while staying focused on outcomes. Experience in education, assessment, workflow automation, integrations, or AI evaluation is helpful, not required. 
 Agentic building: You use AI tools to build working solutions, inspect outputs critically, troubleshoot failures, and improve them. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you enjoy making things work. 
 Ownership and judgment: You can show useful things you have built and shipped, and explain your decisions and results. You may be early in your career; demonstrated ownership matters more than years in a PM title. Personal, academic, internal, and customer projects all count. 
 Customer-close learning: You seek out users and domain experts, test assumptions in real workflows, and turn what you learn into concrete changes. You follow through beyond a demo and communicate tradeoffs clearly. 
 What this role is not 
 Not a role with a ready-made playbook—you won’t always have a defined roadmap, established tools, or an existing solution. The Head of Product sets priorities; you take ownership of figuring out how to achieve the outcome. 
 Not a coordination-only role — you build working solutions and own product outcomes, rather than only writing specs or tracking delivery. 
 Not a solo engineering or domain-expert role — you work hands-on with agentic tools while partnering with customers, Customer Success, specialists, Engineering, and Product Delivery. 
 How we hire We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you've done it. We're hiring for talent that amplifies the team. We evaluate candidates on concrete examples, demonstrably deep knowledge, and real work samples — and on the judgment and self-direction that come from having done work like this before, without a manager scripting the moves. The team you're joining DeweyLearn is a small, close-knit team, moving fast, with a deep conviction in the impact DeweyLearn can have on learning and learners. We emphasize fun and a high level of collaboration, while holding each other accountable to our shared outcomes. We hire on ability and judgment, not pedigree, and we trust deeply once we do. We bias toward straight talk, deliver on what we said we would, and treat play and curiosity as part of how the team discovers what to build. We refuse to ship work we wouldn't be proud of. Benefits Compensation & logistics Medical benefits and flexible PTO. Remote-first, with occasional travel for customer visits and team events. title: Solution Engineer -  FedRAMP
description:
Description About Coralogix 
 Coralogix is a full-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real-time visibility at scale. Our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. With a no-index architecture and in-stream analytics, Coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance. We are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real-world environments. ﻿This is a fully remote position, but candidates must be located within the US Eastern Time Zone (EST/EDT). Compensation : $220,000 to $250,000 OTE The Role We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our East-Coast pre-sales team, Focusing on Enterprise FedRal Cloud Infrastructure clients. This is a senior, hands-on technical sales role. You will partner with Account Executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate Coralogix in their own environments. During evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. You will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate Coralogix across their environment. You need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value. This role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations and help drive deals to a strong technical close. What You’ll Do 
 Own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with Account Executives. 
 Lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria. 
 Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect Coralogix to real customer use cases. 
 Manage technical evaluations and POCs from scope through validation. 
 Support hands-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations. 
 Work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases. 
 Explain Coralogix ’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences. 
 Identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision. 
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to represent field feedback and improve how we win. 
 Requirements 
 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering. 
 Strong hands-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work. 
 Solid understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, APM, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring. 
 Experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept processes. 
 Ability to speak credibly with engineers, DevOps, SRE, platform, and security teams. 
 Confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact. 
 Practical experience with cloud-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure. 
 Coding or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar. 
 Strong communication, ownership, follow-through, and commercial judgment. 
 Technical Experience Relevant experience may include: 
 Kubernetes and containerized environments 
 AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 OpenTelemetry 
 Prometheus 
 Docker 
 APM and distributed tracing 
 Log analytics and telemetry pipelines 
 SIEM or security monitoring 
 Infrastructure monitoring 
 RUM 
 Terraform, Helm, or deployment automation 
 CI/CD workflows 
 Application instrumentation and debugging 
 What Success Looks Like The best Solutions Engineers at Coralogix are not just strong presenters. They are technical owners. They can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. They are hands-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward. They know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate. Why Join Coralogix 
 Observability is changing fast. Data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on. Coralogix gives customers a different path: real-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale. As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose Coralogix . ﻿Compensation and Benefits The on-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, education, and work location. Our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off. Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Cultural Fit We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you. Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Originally posted on Himalayas

We founded the company as a fully-remote team (pre Covid!) and are open to applicants that live within a 5 hour time zone difference of US Pacific Time. The Role Monarch Money is seeking a Principle Software Engineer with a focus on financial data aggregation. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring Monarch reliably aggregates, enriches, and analyzes our users' financial data from various sources and at a large scale. This is a problem that is ripe for innovation, requiring technical excellence, creative problem solving, world-class product intuition, comfort with large volumes of data, and the ability to work with internal and external APIs. This is designed to be a senior role since it is taking ownership of a new area with a lot of technical / product complexity (ie you've probably done this sort of work for years). But if you think you're equipped for the job, please apply! Your Contribution 
 As our first data aggregation engineer, you will lead our technical efforts to make Monarch the best place to see your financial data in one place. This would include writing/improving the code and logic that aggregates, enriches, and analyzes our users' financial data. 
 You will frame the problem, put together a strategy, decide how success should be measured, prioritize projects, and execute successfully. 
 You will collaborate with and influence company and product leadership. 
 While initially working in a hands-on IC capacity, you will own this problem end-to-end, making technical trade-off (like buy vs. build) and product trade-off decisions. 
 You will help build out a team focused on this problem, for which you would have technical and/or people leadership responsibilities. 
 Skills 
 You have excellent product intuition, and are comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative data. 
 You are comfortable working with external APIs (like Plaid). 
 You have experience working with data pipelines and processing data in general. 
 You are comfortable (or willing to learn) Python and other backend systems. 
 You are comfortable delving into front-end work as needed. 
 [Optional] You have some experience or interest in Machine Learning. 
 [Optional] You have worked on aggregating/enriching personal financial data in the past. 
 $180,000 - $200,000 a year Based on seniority and location. Equity is also offered. Benefits 
 Work wherever you want! As a fully remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere. 
 Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀. 
 Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment. 
 Medical, dental and vision benefits (Full time US only). 
 401k (US only). 
 Unlimited PTO. 
 3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!

title: Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - BI & Data Architecture
description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara . We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. 
 
 You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. 
 
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 
 In this role, you will: 
 Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks. 
 Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI. 
 Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. 
 Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. 
 Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. 
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara ’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: 
 Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Economics or other related analytical fields. 
 5+ years of relevant analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence or data engineering work experience. 
 Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred). 
 Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets. 
 Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows. 
 Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. 
 Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. 
 Experience supporting Sales, Product or Marketing teams. 
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 Experience building interactive applications using Streamlit or Claude workflows. 
 Experience building web applications 
 Experience working in web analytics 
 Sales and marketing experience including familiarity with MarTech tools. 
 Navigate large, multifaceted datasets to answer hard questions — drawing on the right analytical or statistical approach for each problem. 
 Data Science, machine learning or predictive analytics experience. 
 Actively builds AI fluency relevant to BI and analytics work, including prompt engineering for data tasks, exploring AI-assisted features in tools, and staying current on how AI is reshaping the analytics landscape. 
 Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. 
 
 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
 Annual Base Salary 
 $119,000—$180,000 USD 
 
 Total Rewards 
 At Samsara , we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 
 Flexible Working 
 At Samsara , we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 
 At Samsara , we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. 
 Accommodations 
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. 
 Our Commitment to Authenticity 
 We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara ’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. 
 Fraudulent Employment Offers 
 Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve. You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated. Responsibilities 
 Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points. 
 Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases. 
 Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence. 
 Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution. 
 Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira. 
 Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint. 
 Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts. 
 Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made. 
 Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage. 
 Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients. 
 Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later. 
 Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts. 
 Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions. 
 Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction. 
 Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs. 
 Requirements 
 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects. 
 Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment. 
 Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements. 
 Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules). 
 Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs. 
 Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders. 
 Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints. 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients. 
 Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech). 
 Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms. 
 Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS. 
 Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects. 
 Company Benefits 
 Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. 
 Generous paid-time-off policy 
 Flexible working hours 
 Work remotely 
 Continuing education, training, conferences 
 Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications 
 Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Security Engineer, Incident Response
description:
At Snowflake , we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake , your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. We are hiring a Senior Security Engineer, dedicated to Product Security Incident Response. In this role, you will lead and architect Snowflake 's product-integrated Incident Response strategy, with a primary focus on AI and LLM security. You'll design, plan, and drive the implementation of incident response capabilities across Snowflake 's AI product surface - including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Snowflake Intelligence, and the data pipelines that power them. AS A SENIOR SECURITY ENGINEER, INCIDENT RESPONSE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 
 Lead incident response for product-level security events, with deep focus on AI-specific threat vectors including prompt injection, model abuse, agent hijacking, and data exfiltration through AI workloads. 
 Integrate IR into AI product pipelines - work directly with teams shipping Cortex features, Snowflake Intelligence, and AI-powered developer experiences to embed security requirements from design through deployment. 
 Develop and codify our AI abuse response strategy - defining detection, containment, and remediation playbooks for LLM misuse, adversarial inputs, and AI-assisted attacks targeting Snowflake customers. 
 Address tech debt across the AI product stack, ensuring that new Cortex and agentic architectures meet IR readiness requirements from the ground up. 
 Represent the IR team to cloud engineering, AI platform teams, corporate security, and customer-facing business units. 
 Secure modern AI-native codebases operating across multi-cloud environments - including container-based inference services, RAG pipelines, vector stores, and agent orchestration layers. 
 Partner with world-class AI and security engineering teams, providing expert guidance on secure architecture for high-impact AI features and customer-facing AI capabilities. 
 Design and manage response capabilities built into Snowflake 's AI operational infrastructure - from model serving endpoints to Cortex Search indexes and Snowpark ML pipelines. 
 Lead with data, code, and automation - build tooling that accelerates detection and response for product security incidents at Snowflake scale. 
 Drive meaningful security outcomes for the customers and enterprises trusting Snowflake with their most sensitive data and AI workloads. 
 OUR IDEAL SENIOR SECURITY ENGINEER WILL HAVE: 
 5+ years of experience in information security, primarily in incident response, security engineering, or product/application security (preferred). 
 Direct experience serving as incident commander for product focused security incidents. 
 Experience leading or actively building an application or security engineering program, with a clear point of view on securing AI/ML systems. 
 Experience with threat modeling and security testing across AI attack surfaces, including prompt injection, indirect injection, model inversion, embedding extraction, and supply chain attacks on AI dependencies. 
 Familiarity with the unique data governance and security challenges introduced by LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic systems. 
 Working knowledge of cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the threat landscape specific to SaaS and AI platforms. 
 SQL proficiency, plus experience building automation and tools with common programming languages (Python preferred). 
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate security risk into actionable guidance for product teams. 
 Empathy for developer experience, helping AI engineers ship securely rather than slowing them down. 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING: 
 Experience securing AI/ML infrastructure, including model serving, vector databases, embedding pipelines, API gateways, and LLM-integrated application architectures. 
 Experience building agentic incident response capabilities, including skills, agents, and pipelines. 
 Understanding of current attacker TTPs, including emerging AI-specific techniques such as adversarial ML, agent manipulation, and LLM jailbreaking in enterprise contexts. 
 Familiarity with CI/CD and secure release lifecycle patterns, with an emphasis on building security into AI feature pipelines. 
 Preferred certifications: GCIA, GCIH, GCSA, GDAT, CISSP/GISP, or cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 WHY JOIN OUR SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE? This is a chance to do incident response at the frontier of AI security, on products that thousands of enterprises rely on. You will work alongside strong AI and security engineering teams, shape how Snowflake responds to novel LLM and agentic threats, and build the tooling and playbooks that define response for AI-native systems. The work is high-impact and highly visible, with direct influence on the trust customers place in Snowflake 's AI capabilities. The application window is expected to be open until September 11, 2026. This opportunity will remain posted based on business needs, which may be before or after the specified date. Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake . How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: 
 The estimated base salary range for this role is $176,000 - $253,000. 
 Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake ’s bonus and equity plan. 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.
