title: Frontend developer
description:
OverIT at a glance OverIT is a global Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company with a strong presence in North America and Europe. We empower organizations in the power, utility, telco, and transportation industries to manage their mission-critical infrastructures efficiently and safely through cutting-edge Field Service Management software solutions. At OverIT , we leverage advanced technologies like ML (Machine Learning), AR (Augmented Reality), IoT (Internet of Things), and GIS (Geographic Information System) to help ensure the infrastructures essential to our daily lives are always on. If you want to be part of a top technology brand, join us! What you’ll do 
 Rebuild and evolve our design system: a library of reusable, accessible Angular components adopted across every product team to accelerate development. 
 Publish and version these components as libraries, with clear documentation, migration guides for breaking changes, and automated test coverage that lets consuming teams upgrade with confidence. 
 Build and maintain applications inside an NX monorepo, structuring libraries, dependency graphs, and workspace boundaries so the codebase scales with the team. 
 Design and implement complex, configuration-driven dynamic forms — forms that adapt their fields, validation, and behavior at runtime, and that stay accessible throughout. 
 Build advanced, high-craft visual experiences — maps, charts, calendars, drag-and-drop interactions — that stay lightweight and intuitive even with dense, real-time data. 
 Champion accessibility as a default in every component and screen, not a checklist item at the end. 
 Design and own comprehensive automated testing strategies for your applications — unit, integration, and especially end-to-end — using Playwright or equivalent for e2e coverage. 
 Bring ideas that improve the overall web Software Development Life Cycle: tooling, build performance, testing strategy, developer experience. 
 Explore and apply AI-native engineering practices in your daily workflow — including agentic development tools and Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) practices — with a clear eye on token consumption and the judgment to know when to lean on AI assistance and when not to. 
 Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 What you’ll need 
 Solid experience in Frontend Engineering, with a proven track record shipping production applications end to end. 
 Deep, hands-on expertise in Angular, including modern patterns (standalone components, signals, reactive forms, RxJS). 
 Real, hands-on experience with NX monorepos — library boundaries, dependency graphs, build caching, and workspace organization at scale. 
 A demonstrated track record building design systems or shared component libraries that other teams actually adopt, not just build and abandon. 
 Experience building genuinely accessible interfaces (WCAG-level thinking, not semantic HTML as an afterthought). 
 Hands-on experience with configuration-driven dynamic forms and advanced data visualizations — charts, maps, calendars, drag-and-drop. 
 Proficiency with Playwright or equivalent and proven experience setting up effective, comprehensive automated testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e) for real-world applications. 
 Genuine, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of your daily workflow — including a track record of leveraging modern LLM-assisted development, awareness of your own token consumption, and the judgment to know when the tools help and when they don't. 
 Strong, well-formed opinions on sticking to industry standards over reinventing the wheel. 
 Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. 
 What’s nice to have 
 Familiarity with OIDC on the frontend — auth flows, token handling, session management. 
 Experience with mapping libraries (e.g., Leaflet, Mapbox, ESRI) or charting libraries at scale. 
 A track record of driving frontend tooling or process improvements beyond your own team. 
 Contributions to open-source projects or other significant personal technical achievements — a strong signal of genuine engineering craft. 
 Accessibility, cloud, or software architecture certifications. 
 What we offer 
 
 OverIT is a unique transformation project in the SaaS space arena, full of ambition to scale and grow globally. 
 International culture and environment with the opportunity to partner with an outstanding group of people and professionals who joined the company to scale and succeed 
 A career-defining opportunity with full exposure to two leading private equity firms. 
 Location-flexible smart working across Italy 
 Competitive pay, meaningful growth opportunities, and a transparent approach to compensation. Salary ranges are defined for each role based on experience, competencies, responsibilities, and geographic location, with additional benefits and performance-based incentives depending on the position. 
 The expected annual gross salary range for this position is €40,000–€55,000. 
 At OverIT we value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, ethnicity, or place of origin. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
description:
About Smart Working 
 
 At Smart Working , we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 
 Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally. 
 Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 
 About the Role 
 
 As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 
 You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 
 The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on. 
 Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. 
 Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date. 
 Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin. 
 Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 Drive the UI through a page object model. 
 Add data-test-ids to React code where missing. 
 Validate correct database state using SQL. 
 Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive. 
 Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned. 
 Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications. 
 Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly. 
 Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation. 
 Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases. 
 Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline. 
 Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break. 
 Requirements 
 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript. 
 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript. 
 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin. 
 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright. 
 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests. 
 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication. 
 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL. 
 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction. 
 Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction. 
 Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications. 
 Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient. 
 Nice to Have 
 Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps. 
 Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test. 
 Experience reading and working with React front-end code. 
 Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework. 
 Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC. 
 Experience in another regulated or audited environment. 
 ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing. 
 Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC. 
 Healthtech or digital health domain experience. 
 Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow. 
 Benefits 
 Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter) 
 No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words 
 Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided 
 Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared 
 True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve. You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated. Responsibilities 
 Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points. 
 Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases. 
 Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence. 
 Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution. 
 Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira. 
 Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint. 
 Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts. 
 Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made. 
 Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage. 
 Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients. 
 Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later. 
 Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts. 
 Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions. 
 Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction. 
 Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs. 
 Requirements 
 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects. 
 Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment. 
 Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements. 
 Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules). 
 Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs. 
 Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders. 
 Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints. 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients. 
 Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech). 
 Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms. 
 Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS. 
 Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects. 
 Company Benefits 
 Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. 
 Generous paid-time-off policy 
 Flexible working hours 
 Work remotely 
 Continuing education, training, conferences 
 Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

When a Zscaler team member, a customer, or a partner hits a compliance requirement, our practice is who they call trust to answer. You'll be one of the people behind building trust: part advisor, part translator, part teacher. You'll help customers navigate compliance frameworks like Zero Trust, GDPR, NIST, PCI, and HIPAA, and you'll help our field teams turn compliance requirements into relevant, relevant, and winning conversations. title: Relief Referral Coordinator
description:
Department Overview The Referral Coordinator is responsible for the intake, triage, validation, and accurate processing of externally referred patient care requests received for OHSU ambulatory clinics and diagnostic services. This role is often the first step in the care process for patients beginning care at OHSU, serving as a critical point of entry into the health system and supporting timely, accurate, and appropriate access to care and services. The Referral Coordinator reviews referral documentation submitted by external providers, which may include medical diagnoses, procedures, imaging or diagnostic testing requests, urgency indicators, and supporting clinical records. Using established intake criteria, diagnosis and referral matrices, and department workflows, this role independently determines referral completeness, urgency, and appropriate routing within OHSU’s electronic medical record (Epic). This position requires regular interpretation of medical terminology and ICD10 diagnosis codes, application of intake rules, and precise documentation to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and continuity of care. While this role does not provide direct clinical care, the work performed directly impacts patient access, clinic workflow, and the timely delivery of care. The Referral Coordinator functions as a member of the Ambulatory Access Services department, supporting centralized access, outpatient clinics and diagnostic services from the point an external referral is received through referral entry and routing for scheduling and clinical review. Function/Duties of Position Referral Intake, Triage, and Processing 
 Receive, review, and process incoming referrals and related documentation from external providers using Epic and various referral sources. 
 Validate referral completeness, including required patient demographics, referring provider information, diagnoses and/or procedures, requested services, and supporting documentation (as needed). 
 Interpret referral documentation containing medical terminology, diagnostic language, urgency indicators, and procedural requests. 
 Review and enter diagnoses using ICD10 codes or approved free text selections when coded diagnoses are not provided. 
 Apply established intake, diagnosis, and specialty specific referral matrices to determine appropriate clinic, specialty, diagnostic department, or program routing. 
 Assess and assign referral priority levels (routine, urgent, emergent) based on referring provider documentation and intake standards. 
 Create and manage referral records in Epic, ensuring accurate selection of referral type, department, location, and point of service. 
 Attach referral documentation to the correct Epic referral, confirming accurate patient identification using required identifiers. 
 Identify incomplete, misdirected, or inappropriate referrals and route them to the appropriate workflow for resolution, exercising independent judgment within established protocols. 
 Communication and Coordination 
 Communicate with referring providers, clinic staff, internal stakeholders and rarely patients to obtain missing clinical information, diagnoses, procedure, or demographic details required to complete referral intake. 
 Clarify referral intent, urgency, or destination when documentation is unclear or conflicting. 
 Document referral intake actions, decisions, and discrepancies using standardized Epic communication notes and documentation tools. 
 Escalate complex referrals, routing uncertainties, access barriers, or potential safety concerns to supervisors or designated leads in accordance with department protocols. 
 Support the centralized access model for referral intake and scheduled patient care, contributing to efficient coordination and timely access to services. 
 Monitoring, quality, and continuous improvement 
 Identify trends, workflow barriers, and quality concerns impacting referral accuracy, timeliness, or patient access 
 Report issues, challenges, and potential risks to leadership to support operational improvement and patient safety efforts. 
 Participate in discussions related to optimizing intake workflows, referral accuracy, and Epic system performance. 
 Referral routing matrix maintenance 
 Participate in the review and recommendation of updates to intake, diagnosis, and referral matrices to ensure accurate routing and alignment with clinic criteria. 
 Validate matrix accuracy related to diagnostic terminology, procedures, clinic restrictions, and specialty workflows in collaboration with leadership. 
 Other duties as assigned Perform additional duties in support of Centralized Access Service operations as assigned. Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree plus 2 years’ experience working in an ambulatory clinic, 
 OR

title: Solutions Architect
description:
The Solutions Architect is a senior technical and consultative member of the Professional Services team responsible for translating client business needs into secure, scalable, supportable, and cost-effective technology solutions. The Solutions Architect leads technical discovery, defines architecture and implementation strategies, and develops clear, accurate scopes of work for clients’ technology needs. The Solutions Architect owns solution design quality and delivery readiness, while engineering owns implementation. In partnership with Account Management, vCIOs, engineering, project management, procurement, vendors, and client stakeholders, the Solutions Architect guides opportunities from initial discovery and pre-sales consultation through solution approval and delivery handoff. The position requires sound technical judgment, strong business acumen, disciplined documentation, and the ability to communicate complex recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Key Duties & Responsibilities 
 Lead technical discovery and current-state assessments to understand client business objectives, operational requirements, existing environments, technical debt, dependencies, constraints, risks, and future-state goals. 
 Translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, supportable, and cost-effective solution architectures across Microsoft cloud services, infrastructure, networking, identity, cybersecurity, business continuity, and related managed services. 
 Incorporate security, privacy, compliance, resiliency, data protection, monitoring, scalability, licensing, supportability, and technology lifecycle requirements into solution designs. 
 Develop accurate and detailed Statements of Work, solution diagrams, bills of materials, implementation approaches, effort estimates, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, deliverables, timelines, and acceptance criteria. 
 Partner with Account Management and vCIO teams during pre-sales activities, client presentations, solution reviews, roadmap discussions, and proposal development to communicate recommendations, value, tradeoffs, and technical considerations clearly. 
 Establish and maintain architecture principles, approved technology standards, reference architectures, design patterns, documentation templates, and exception processes aligned with CompassMSP ’s service catalog and strategic direction. 
 Conduct or participate in peer and architecture reviews for complex or high-risk solutions to confirm design quality, standards alignment, delivery readiness, and appropriate risk mitigation before client approval. 
 Coordinate structured handoffs to project management and engineering teams, document key architectural decisions and risks, and serve as an escalation resource for design questions, scope gaps, and technical blockers during delivery. 
 Engage vendors and distributors to evaluate technologies, validate technical fit, confirm pricing and availability, assess product roadmaps and lifecycle status, and coordinate complex solution requirements. 
 Review completed engagements, delivery feedback, technology changes, and project outcomes to improve estimating accuracy, architecture quality, service offerings, reusable standards, and internal processes. 
 Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to sales, account management, vCIO, engineering, project management, and service delivery teams while managing multiple opportunities and priorities with accountability, urgency, and consistent follow-through. 
 Success Indicators 
 Solution designs and Statements of Work are complete, technically accurate, aligned with documented client objectives, security requirements, architectural standards, and budget expectations, and delivered within established turnaround targets. 
 Projects are scoped with appropriate detail, labor hours, costs, risks, and margin assumptions, enabling delivery on time, within budget, and at or above targeted profitability with minimal corrective change after approval. 
 Project management and engineering teams receive clear, complete documentation and structured handoffs that minimize scope gaps, avoidable escalations, rework, and implementation delays. 
 Clients and internal partners receive timely, credible technical guidance that supports informed decisions, strengthens proposal quality, and contributes to qualified revenue growth. 
 Standards, templates, reference architectures, estimating practices, and service offerings are continuously improved based on delivery results, technology changes, and stakeholder feedback. 
 Internal teams and clients consistently demonstrate confidence in the Solutions Architect’s responsiveness, communication, technical judgment, accountability, and follow-through. 
 Job Qualifications 
 8+ years of progressive IT experience, including at least two years in a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Senior Systems Engineer, or comparable client-facing architecture role. 
 Demonstrated experience in a Managed Service Provider environment and a strong understanding of recurring services, project delivery, supportability, and client lifecycle considerations. 
 Broad technical expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, virtualization, identity, networking, security, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint technologies. 
 Proven ability to conduct discovery, evaluate complex environments, and design solutions that balance technical requirements, business outcomes, risk, cost, and operational readiness. 
 Experience in creating detailed Statements of Work, solution diagrams, bills of materials, project estimates, and executive-ready proposals. 
 Strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with solution costing, licensing, procurement, margin considerations, and the factors that influence successful project delivery. 
 Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and produce accurate work under deadlines. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, account management, vCIO, engineering, project management, procurement, finance, vendors, and client stakeholders.

 Collaborative and engaging work environment

title: Senior Threat Detection Engineer
description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl , we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next. 
 We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. 
 Why You’ll Love This Role Cribl builds telemetry infrastructure for some of the world's biggest security teams. Now we're looking for someone to protect Cribl itself. You'll join Cribl 's internal security team, Team Alpine, to run detection as code. Our team runs a detection as code pipeline where rules live in Git, are tested in CI, and deploy to our SIEM automatically. AI agents watch for coverage gaps and help review every change. This is a hands-on senior role covering the whole detection lifecycle. You'll hunt for threats nobody has written a rule for yet, turn what you find into detections, and keep the log pipelines behind those detections healthy. For the first [6–12] months you'll also be a core part of our incident response rotation while we build out that function. You'll lead investigations, and what you learn will feed straight back into the detections. If you want your work to show up in production quickly, and you like owning the data as well as the rules, this role is for you. You will partner closely with Product Security, IT, and Legal teams, and report to the Sr. Director, Security Engineering and Operations under the CISO. 
 As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will… Detection Engineering 
 Design, build, test, and tune detections as code (KQL) through a GitOps workflow: issue, pull request, unit and back-testing, then automated deployment 
 Map detections to MITRE ATT&CK, find coverage gaps, and decide where to invest next based on our threat model 
 Review new community and vendor rule releases, such as Sigma, and decide what to adopt, adapt, or skip 
 Cut alert noise by tuning, retiring rules that no longer earn their place, and tracking detection quality metrics 
 Threat Hunting 
 Plan and run hypothesis-driven hunts across cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, and corporate infrastructure telemetry 
 Use adversary emulation to generate test events for detections that have nothing to fire on yet 
 Turn hunt findings into durable detections, documentation, and backlog items 
 Incident Response (initial [6–12] months) 
 Take part in the IR rotation: triage, scope, contain, and investigate security incidents from first alert to closure 
 Run retrospectives and turn the lessons into new detections, playbook updates, and fixes to visibility gaps 
 Write and maintain runbooks so others on the team can respond consistently 
 Detection Infrastructure & Log Pipelines 
 Assist in ownership of the health of security log flow: onboard new sources, maintain parsing and normalization, and monitor for dropped, delayed, or malformed data 
 Assist and Build and maintain data pipelines with Cribl Stream to route, enrich, and reduce telemetry before it reaches the SIEM 
 Maintain the CI/CD and automation behind the detection program, including GitHub Actions, SIEM API integrations, and AI-assisted gap analysis and PR review 
 Across the Team 
 Work independently, and design the processes, standards, and tools that help others work well 
 Mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and clear documentation 
 Work with IT, Infrastructure, Engineering, and GRC to close visibility gaps and improve detection coverage 
 This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties 
 
 If You’ve Got It - We Want It 
 [5+] years in security operations, with significant hands-on time in detection engineering, threat hunting, or incident response 
 Experience writing and maintaining detections as code in a modern SIEM 
 Strong Python skills and comfort with Git-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD 
 Strong in KQL for writing detection queries 
 Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and how to use it for coverage analysis, not just labeling 
 Experience investigating incidents in cloud (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure), SaaS, and identity providers 
 Hands-on experience with log pipelines: getting data in, parsing it, and fixing it when it breaks 
 The judgment to separate a real signal from noise, and to know when to escalate 
 Clear writing for both technical and non-technical audiences: incident summaries, runbooks, detection docs 
 Uses AI as a routine part of engineering work, with concrete examples of how it has changed how you build, test, or investigate 
 Bonus: experience with Cribl Stream or other telemetry pipeline tools 
 Bonus: experience with Sigma rules, adversary emulation (Atomic Red Team, Caldera, or similar), or purple teaming 
 Bonus: experience building agentic or AI-assisted workflows for security operations 
 Bonus: certifications such as GCIH,GCDA, or equivalent experience 
 
 The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program. In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

 $108,000—$169,000 USD

title: Paralegal, Emerging Companies & Venture Capital
description:
Location: United States (Remote-friendly) Type: Full-time Compensation: $100,000–$120,000 base salary, commensurate with experience About General Legal 
 General Legal is an AI-native law firm built to deliver high-quality corporate legal work faster and more predictably than traditional firms. We combine top-of-market, U.S.-barred attorneys with AI-native workflows to handle drafting, review, and negotiation end to end—without billable hours, bloated process, or junior handoffs. We operate like a startup because we are one. That means modern tooling, outcome-based pricing, remote-friendly work, and a focus on building repeatable processes that scale. By using AI to handle the routine parts of legal work, we give our team the space to focus on judgment and the issues that actually matter to clients. We’re starting with commercial and emerging companies work for growing companies—and we’re looking for a paralegal who wants to do great work in a firm that’s rethinking how legal services get delivered. The Role We’re hiring a Paralegal to support our Emerging Companies & Venture Capital (ECVC) practice—working directly with our attorneys on financings, formations, equity administration, and startup-side M&A for a growing roster of startup and investor clients. This is a hands-on execution role: you’ll own the corporate housekeeping and deal-support work that keeps our clients’ cap tables clean and their transactions moving, and you’ll use AI-native workflows to do it faster and more accurately than you could at a traditional firm. The ideal candidate has real ECVC paralegal experience—venture financings, entity formation, and cap table/equity plan administration—and is comfortable working independently in a lean, fast-moving team with direct attorney and client contact. What You’ll Do Startup & Venture Financings 
 Support venture financings (priced rounds, SAFEs, convertible notes) from term sheet through closing, including drafting ancillary documents, preparing signature pages, and managing signature/closing logistics. 
 Incorporate and organize new entities—formation documents, bylaws/operating agreements, initial resolutions, and corporate records setup. 
 Implement and administer equity incentive plans and stock option grants, including board and stockholder approvals. 
 Maintain and update capitalization tables and equity records using platforms such as Carta or Shareworks; manage related cap table due diligence. 
 Handle corporate records management and general corporate housekeeping for clients on an ongoing basis (annual filings, franchise tax, registered agent matters, minute books). 
 Startup-Side M&A Support 
 Assist with diligence for acquisitions of early- and growth-stage companies, acqui-hires, and asset deals—organizing data rooms, tracking diligence requests, and flagging issues for attorney review. 
 Draft and manage signing and closing checklists, closing documents, and closing volumes. 
 Prepare board and stockholder resolutions and minutes in connection with financings, M&A, and other corporate actions. 
 Client & Attorney Support 
 Serve as a direct point of contact for founders and clients on routine document requests, closing logistics, and status updates. 
 Draft and revise standard agreements and templates under attorney direction. 
 Work directly with attorneys to scope and prioritize matters, and flag issues that need attorney judgment early. 
 Process & Tooling 
 Use and help refine AI-native workflows and playbooks to handle routine drafting, document assembly, and diligence work faster. 
 Identify recurring bottlenecks in deal or intake workflows and help build better process as the firm scales. 
 Who You Are Background & Experience 
 3+ years of corporate/transactional paralegal experience, with substantive ECVC experience: incorporations, venture financings, and cap table/equity plan administration. 
 Experience with capitalization management platforms such as Carta or Shareworks. 
 A four-year degree and/or a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program. 
 Experience in a law firm, legal tech, or in-house legal environment; startup or high-growth company exposure strongly preferred. 
 Solid working knowledge of NVCA-style financing documents, SAFEs, and convertible notes; exposure to startup-side M&A (asset deals, acqui-hires, company sales) is a plus. 
 Substantial experience with Excel spreadsheets and exemplary written communication and organizational skills. 
 How You Work 
 You can run the mechanics of a financing or closing without hand-holding, and you know when something needs attorney judgment instead. 
 You’re comfortable multi-tasking across several active matters in a deadline-driven environment. 
 You’re genuinely curious about AI tools and excited to work somewhere that uses them to change how legal services get delivered—not just tolerate the idea. 
 You default to fixing the problem rather than just flagging it.

 401(k) with 5% employer match. 
 Health & dental insurance fully covered, with partial subsidies for dependents. 
 Annual team onsites. 
 Training and development stipend.

description: Overview ABOUT JAGGAER : JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. title: Solutions Architect, Observe
description:
At Snowflake , we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake , your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake 's Observe business unit delivers AI-powered observability at enterprise scale, unifying logs, metrics, and traces across petabytes of telemetry data into a single, trusted, Snowflake -native platform. As organizations shift from reactive monitoring to proactive, automated troubleshooting, the implementation experience becomes a critical driver of product value. Solutions Architects are the architectural foundation of the Observe post-sales practice. They bring deep platform and observability domain expertise to design durable, scalable architectures, ensuring every enterprise implementation starts with a sound technical foundation that Implementation Engineers (IEs) execute with confidence and customers build on for years. By owning the architecture layer, and establishing shared standards that demonstrate what great looks like, Solutions Architects multiply the effectiveness of the entire go-to-market team. This role is ideal for a technically exceptional practitioner who has moved beyond execution into architecture. Someone who can assess a complex enterprise environment, design an observability system built to scale, document it with precision, and hand it off with confidence. WHAT YOU'LL DO: 
 Take an active role in technical discovery on SA-attached engagements, working in tandem with the Implementation Engineer to assess existing telemetry, infrastructure, data volumes, tooling landscape, and operational requirements 
 Design end-to-end observability architectures on Observe, covering telemetry ingestion, pipeline topology, data modeling, enrichment and normalization strategies, alerting design, and long-term retention 
 Define the implementation approach and architecture blueprint that Implementation Engineering teams execute against 
 Validate that proposed configurations, pipelines, and data models will meet production-scale requirements before execution begins 
 Advise customers on OpenTelemetry adoption strategies 
 Have an active role in the architecture and planning phases of enterprise engagements, working in tandem with the IE from kickoff through handoff to dedicated IE team(s) 
 Produce clear, high-quality handoff artifacts (e.g. reference architectures, design decision records, implementation plans, and configuration standards) 
 Remain available to Implementation teams during execution for architectural blockers, scope changes, or decisions requiring architectural judgment 
 Conduct formal go-live architecture reviews to validate that the implemented solution matches the designed architecture and is production-ready 
 Design the target architecture and phased cutover strategy for complex migrations from existing observability platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic) onto Observe, minimizing disruption to production operations 
 Identify architectural gaps, data quality risks, and technical debt in existing environments; design clean, scalable replacements where appropriate 
 Partner with the Director of Implementation Engineering to develop and own internal reference architectures, design documents, runbooks, and implementation standards 
 Build and maintain field demo infrastructure — realistic, production-grade environments that pre-sales and IE teams use to show customers what a well-architected Observe deployment looks like 
 Capture reusable patterns from field engagements and translate them into assets the broader IE team can apply consistently 
 Serve as a technical authority on complex or novel customer scenarios 
 Act as a force multiplier for the IE team; set the technical example, structure, and tone on an engagement, and mentor and level up junior Implementation Engineers rather than taking over their work 
 Contribute beyond core Observe architecture where the engagement calls for it; integration with adjacent solutions and technologies, process (re-)engineering, and AI refactoring 
 Contribute field insights back to Product and Engineering to influence the platform roadmap 
 WHAT YOU BRING: 
 8+ years in customer-facing technical roles; Solutions Architect, Staff/Principal engineer, observability engineer, or SRE; with a demonstrated shift from hands-on execution to architecture-level thinking 
 Deep expertise in observability platforms and telemetry systems at scale, including data modeling tradeoffs across logs, metrics, and traces 
 Strong hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry: instrumentation strategies, collector configuration, exporters, and multi-signal pipeline design 
 Proven ability to design or lead migrations from commercial observability platforms (Splunk, ELK, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) to modern alternatives 
 Experience assessing complex enterprise environments and producing architectural designs that are durable, scalable, and practical to implement 
 Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized workloads, and Kubernetes-based environments 
 Strong communication skills; credible with both hands-on engineering teams and senior technical leadership 
 Experience producing high-quality technical documentation: architecture diagrams, design decision records, runbooks, implementation plans 
 Exposure to AI-assisted observability or AIOps 
 NICE TO HAVE: 
 Background in SRE, platform engineering, or DevOps with firsthand experience operating production observability at scale 
 Experience authoring internal standards, reference architectures, and enablement content for post-sales or pre-sales teams 
 Experience building or maintaining demo or lab environments for internal field teams 
 Familiarity with Kubernetes-native observability patterns and cloud-native monitoring tooling 
 Experience working in or alongside professional services organizations 
 Experience working directly with Observe. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS 
 Time-to-first-value for new Observe customers 
 Customer satisfaction scores (post-engagement NPS/CSAT) 
 On-time and on-scope delivery rate 
 Escalation rate and time to resolution 
 Observe consumption growth attributable to successful implementations

We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake . title: Senior Mainframe Systems Programmer - IMS Phyical
description:
Position Summary Provide premium software support and services to Ensono mainframe clients as they relate to Mainframe IMS systems. Position reports to Senior Manager - Mainframe Systems Programming Key Areas of Focus for this Role Fulfill customer service requests for mainframe z/OS customers in a timely manner as they pertain to IMS and related OEM software products. Provide primary support for reported problems related to IMS and related OEM software products. Provide support on 24 x 7 x 365 basis across multiple time zones. Follow procedures for installing OEM software products efficiently and according to best practices and Ensono standards (for productivity/scalability purposes). Provide key support for customer migration services (new customer transitions) as they pertain to IMS and related OEM software products. Assist the assigned project manager in the migration of newly acquired customers such that all technical hurdles are addressed in a timely manner and do not impede the expected progress of the transition nor the targeted migration date. In joint cooperation with the Disaster Recovery Services, successfully execute tasks associated with any given customer’s disaster recovery plans. Adhere to a schedule that efficiently manages resources and allows timely implementations. Follow ITSM change control procedures What the Ideal Candidate Brings to this Role Required Qualifications help to assure new Associates are set up for success in their role with Ensono . To be considered for this career opportunity, it is important that you meet all Required Qualifications. Candidates that may meet some, but not all, Other Qualifications are still encouraged to apply. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required and/or equivalent work experience. 10+ years of professional experience in IMS for administration and systems programming support.  CA and IBM tools for IMS a plus Extensive experience with the following: Knowledge in best practices of software management, maintenance and documentation Configure and manage IMS in a parallel sysplex environment Develop innovation, strategies, processes and  best practices in IMS systems programming Troubleshooting and solving of IMS System and database issues Evaluating change requests and determine impact to assigned clients Troubleshooting and solving production database issues Strong JCL skills Database Administration Knowledge of IMS database organization using access methods of VSAM and OSAM Full function database organization types: HSAM, HISAM, SHISAM, HDAM, HIDAM, INDEX, GSAM Definition and use of LOGICAL databases: HALDB (partitioned):  PHDAM, PHIDAM, ILDS, PSINDEX, etc. Knowledge of Fast Path databases (DEDBs) Database Design and related utilities DBD source coding and DBDGEN PSB source coding and PSBGEN How databases are processed using secondary indexes (PROCSEQ=) Correct usage of PROCOPT= to minimize database locking Understanding of path calls 
 Understanding of bi-directional logical relationships 
 Understanding and use of Data Set Groups 
 Other Qualifications Reviewing new versions of IMS for functionality, advising how they benefit the client Vendor consultations for problems and questions DR recovery of application objects IMS commands related to ACB and FORMAT changes Coding and usage of IMS reorganization utilities (including IBM, BMC, CA) Knowledge of log archive and change accumulation utilities Identification and resolution of performance issues  Online tracing - Usage of IMS TRACE commands and associated utilities for spot monitoring of online program/transaction activity A solid working knowledge of SMP/E and its role in the installation process Solid understanding of IMS database structures Understanding of IMS connect, MFS for IMS message formatting, Compression routines, Randomizers, Assembler, exits in the install process, and IRLM in a data sharing environment Extracting information from IMS logs Using DBRC to monitor database activity Why Ensono ?  Ensono is a place we unleash Associates to Do Great Things – for our clients and for your career. This could mean achieving a professional goal, collaborating with your team on an innovative idea, learning a new skill, reaching a wellness milestone, or engaging in your community through volunteer programs. Whatever it means to you, we want Ensono to be the place where you can do great things.     Some of our benefits include:   Unlimited Paid Days Off   Three health plan options   401k with company match   Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts   Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement   Paid childbearing and paternal leave   Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding   Sabbatical leave   Wellness program   Flexible work schedule      As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $85,000 to $148,000 salary, based on a fulltime schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include   an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance   and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.     Ensono is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment to our Associates and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.     Pay transparency nondiscrimination statement/posting OFCCP’s pay transparency policy can be found on OFCCP’s website.     If you need accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email .  Originally posted on Himalayas

The Role Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader. The Director - Audience Data Partnerships is responsible for the adoption and commercial success of Crossix Audiences products. In this role, you will work closely with the Sales team acting as a market owner and subject matter expert on Crossix data, methodologies, products, and differentiators.  Understanding of the digital ecosystem with 8+ years experience at ad tech or media companies or agencies. 
 High-performing client-facing individual contributor with a track record of managing strategic accounts, revenue expansion, and achieving goals. 
 Expert data storyteller. 
 Commitment to building meaningful relationships through a consultative sales approach. 
 Enjoys a fast-paced work environment and has strong time management and prioritization skills.

title: Head of Digital Demand Generation & Growth Marketing
description:
Description VAST Data is the AI Operating System company, redefining how organizations build and operate intelligent systems at scale. As enterprises, AI-native companies, and cloud providers move from isolated models to fully operational AI systems, the need for a unified data and compute platform has become mission-critical. About the role: ﻿ We're looking for a Director of Digital Demand Generation & Growth Marketing to lead our Paid Media and Campaigns team and build a modern, AI-powered demand engine. This is a revenue-first leadership role responsible for generating qualified pipeline through digital marketing. You'll own strategy, execution, and optimization across paid channels and integrated campaigns, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to accelerate growth. Success in this role is measured by business outcomes and not marketing activity. AI Experience ﻿ We're looking for a leader who understands how AI is transforming demand generation. Experience building or deploying agentic AI solutions is highly desirable, including systems that autonomously optimize paid campaigns, recommend budget allocation, improve lead routing, identify funnel bottlenecks, and create closed-loop optimization between marketing performance and CRM data. Responsibilities 
 Own digital demand generation strategy across paid media and integrated campaigns. 
 Lead and develop the Paid Media, Campaign and Content Operations team. 
 Drive net new lead generation, marketing-sourced pipeline, and revenue contribution. 
 Optimize the entire demand funnel from Lead → MQL → SQO, improving conversion rates and pipeline velocity. 
 Manage paid acquisition across Search, LinkedIn, Display, YouTube, and emerging channels. 
 Lead the Content Operations function to ensure content lifecycle management, CMS governance, and repurposing workflows are optimized to fuel paid media and campaign performance. 
 Build a culture of testing, measurement, and continuous optimization using data and attribution. 
 Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Field and Event Marketing Managers, Comms, Organic Social team and Marketing Operations to maximize pipeline impact. 
 Leverage AI and automation to improve campaign execution, lead management, and marketing efficiency. 
 Requirements 
 10+ years in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing. 
 5+ years leading high-performing marketing teams. 
 Proven track record driving measurable pipeline and revenue through paid media and integrated campaigns. 
 Strong analytical and attribution skills with experience optimizing complex marketing funnels. 
 Experience with modern marketing technology and CRM platforms. 
 Experience applying AI to demand generation workflows; hands-on experience with agentic AI or autonomous marketing systems is a strong plus.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve. You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated. Responsibilities 
 Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points. 
 Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases. 
 Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence. 
 Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution. 
 Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira. 
 Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint. 
 Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts. 
 Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made. 
 Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage. 
 Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients. 
 Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later. 
 Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts. 
 Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions. 
 Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction. 
 Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs. 
 Requirements 
 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects. 
 Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment. 
 Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements. 
 Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules). 
 Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs. 
 Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders. 
 Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints. 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients. 
 Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech). 
 Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms. 
 Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS. 
 Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects. 
 Company Benefits 
 Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. 
 Generous paid-time-off policy 
 Flexible working hours 
 Work remotely 
 Continuing education, training, conferences 
 Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications 
 Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Role

As an Applied Scientist Intern, you will become a specialist in our models, products, business and/or codebase. You will identify potential problems or opportunities for improvement, communicate these to the team and suggest solutions. This involves self-directed investigation, offline analyses using creative thinking as well as presentation to the ML team. You will receive mentorship from experienced ML practitioners and collaborate closely with the team to improve our products and models.

How you’ll make an impact

Research machine learning and statistical approaches to discover improvements to the predictive performance and/or business value of a model.

Design, implement, and evaluate model, product, or technical enhancements using rigorous experimentation and validation methods.

Translate research findings into clear recommendations, documented methodologies, and production-ready solutions.

Work with your mentor to align stakeholders, and drive next steps.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor. Masters or PHD degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. On track to graduate by 2028.

Strong fundamentals in statistical, probability, and machine learning theory.

Ability to perform data analysis and evaluate machine learning or statistical models using Python, as well as basic SQL foundations.

Intellectual curiosity, humility, drive and teamwork.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to use modern agentic tooling (Claude Code, Codex, …) efficiently.

Preferred Qualifications

Phd in mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. On track to graduate by the summer of 2028.

Experience in supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering techniques.

Advanced statistical (frequentist, bayesian, causal) theory/econometrics knowledge.

Strong coding skills in Python.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview

This role owns Amwell's marketing web estate and how discoverable it is, across four properties: SilverCloud, business.amwell.com, patients.amwell.com, and LiveHealthOnline. Accountability covers performance and conversion on those properties, the compliance posture of what runs on them, and discoverability as search behavior shifts toward AI-generated answers.

The role directs work rather than performing all of it. Engineering owns development capacity and Design owns visual execution; this role defines, sequences, and holds the quality of the work both produce for the web estate. Page content and messaging remain with the pillar that owns each page, so this role owns the platform and its performance rather than what the pages say.

Core Responsibilities

What the role owns:

• The four web properties — performance, conversion, and delivery

• Web compliance and governance, including cookie consent and tracking governance

• GEO and AI-answer discoverability across the properties, alongside conventional search performance

• Definition and sequencing of website build and development work delivered by Engineering

• Coordination with the separate Design team on visual work for the estate

• The web roadmap and the case for what it returns

How success is measured:

• Conversion performance across the four properties, and measured improvement in GEO and AI-answer discoverability (primary measurable output)

• Web property performance, including speed and core experience measures

• Tracking-compliance coverage across the estate

• Delivery of the web roadmap against plan

• Contribution of web to demand and engagement funnels

What the role does not own:

Scope boundaries are explicit, so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

• Page content and messaging — each pillar owns what its own pages say

• Product application surfaces — Product

• Engineering development capacity itself — Engineering owns the resource; this role directs the work

• Visual design execution — the separate Design team

• Off-site authority and earned citations — Brand and Corporate Marketing with the external agency

• Paid media and demand strategy — Demand Generation Manager

Qualifications

• 7+ years in web, digital marketing, or growth, with direct ownership of a web estate

• A track record of moving a conversion measure on owned properties, not only of shipping site work

• Technical SEO depth, and demonstrated engagement with GEO and AI-answer discoverability

• Experience directing engineering delivery without owning the engineering resource

• Web compliance and tracking governance experience, including consent management

• Analytics fluency sufficient to defend what the web numbers claim

• The ability to hold a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands from multiple pillars

Preferred

• Healthcare or other regulated-industry web experience, including accessibility obligations

• Multi-property or multi-brand estate management

• CMS migration or replatforming experience

• Experience establishing GEO measurement where no baseline existed

Employee Stock Purchase Program

Pet Insurance

title: ALM Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States | Remote

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart Bank is a purpose-built, technology-enabled bank that combines innovative lending with disciplined balance sheet and risk management. The Treasury team supports sustainable growth by managing the Bank's funding, liquidity, capital, investment portfolio, and interest rate risk across changing market conditions and economic cycles.

As the ALM Manager, you will own the Bank's first-line asset and liability management and interest rate risk management framework. Reporting to the Bank Treasurer, you will lead implementation and ongoing operation of the Bank's ALM platform, develop and govern key behavioral assumptions, analyze net interest income and economic value sensitivity, and translate model results into balance sheet and risk-management recommendations. You will partner closely with Finance, Risk, Lending, Deposit Product, Accounting, Data, Engineering, and Regulatory Reporting to support a resilient and well-managed balance sheet.

How you’ll make an impact

Own the Bank's asset and liability management and interest rate risk measurement framework, including net interest income simulation, economic value of equity sensitivity, repricing gap analysis, and other measures used to assess earnings and capital exposure across changing rate environments.

Lead implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of the Bank's ALM platform, including data mapping and staging, source-to-model reconciliations, model controls, change management, vendor coordination, and issue resolution.

Develop, document, and regularly evaluate behavioral and market assumptions, including deposit betas and decay, loan prepayments and curtailments, repricing characteristics, funding rollover behavior, yield curves, and product optionality; perform sensitivity analysis, backtesting, and outcomes analysis.

Design and evaluate parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, ramps, curve twists, and business-plan scenarios; identify key drivers of risk, monitor limits and early warning indicators, and explain period-over-period changes in the Bank's interest rate risk profile.

Recommend balance sheet, product pricing, funding, investment, and hedging actions to manage interest rate risk within approved appetite and limits, and partner with business leaders to assess the ALM implications of new products and changes in balance sheet strategy.

Prepare clear, decision-useful ALM and IRR reporting for the Asset and Liability Committee, executive management, the Board, Internal Audit, and regulators, while supporting policy administration, model risk management, independent validation, examinations, audits, and continuous improvement of Treasury reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

10+ years of experience in bank treasury, asset and liability management, interest rate risk management, balance sheet management, or a closely related discipline.

Experience working within a commercial bank, community bank, or bank holding company and applying bank ALM and interest rate risk concepts in a regulated environment.

Hands-on experience operating an ALM platform and producing net interest income and economic value sensitivity analyses under multiple rate and balance sheet scenarios.

Experience developing and governing model assumptions, reconciling source data to model inputs, analyzing model results, monitoring policy limits, and preparing ALM or IRR reporting for senior management or an Asset and Liability Committee.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience presenting ALM and interest rate risk analyses to an Asset and Liability Committee, executive management, a Board or Board committee, auditors, and bank regulators.

Knowledge of applicable bank regulatory guidance for interest rate risk and model risk management, including OCC, Federal Reserve, and FDIC supervisory expectations.

Experience with fixed-rate consumer lending, retail and wholesale deposits, investment securities, derivatives, and the balance sheet dynamics of a de novo or rapidly growing bank.

Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills; proficiency with SQL or similar data tools; and familiarity with ALM platforms such as Empyrean, QRM, BancWare, Moody's Analytics, or similar systems.

Experience supporting independent model validation, assumption backtesting, model change governance, hedging analysis, or funds transfer pricing; CFA, FRM, or another relevant professional credential is a plus.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

title: Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote US

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

What We Look For

1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.
