title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Austin, TX, USA
description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on

Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests

Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work

Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them

Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows

A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does

A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster

The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally

Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for

Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec

Excellent communication skills

Bonus

Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects

Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Virtual Data Rooms: APAC
description:
Company Description: Valutico is the world’s leading AI-powered valuation platform, powering hundreds of M&A advisors, private equity funds, and corporate finance teams worldwide. In 2025 we launched DoneDiligence, our AI-native Virtual Data Room, built from scratch for how M&A deals actually run today.

DoneDiligence pairs a secure, scalable VDR with AI built into every room. Buyer questions get answered directly from the documents. New uploads are indexed automatically. Missing or inconsistent items surface before they hit the Q&A queue. Teasers and CIMs are drafted from the source material in a fraction of the manual time.

We are building the next generation of deal execution infrastructure, where valuation, data rooms, and AI-powered analysis come together in one seamless workflow.

The Opportunity:

This is not a generalist SDR seat. We are hiring someone who already knows the Virtual Data Room world – who has prospected into deal teams, heard the objections, and understands what a data room actually has to do during a live process. You will be the first touch for DoneDiligence, generating the conversations our Account Executives close.

You will work the APAC M&A market – advisory boutiques and investment banks, private equity and venture capital funds, and corporate development teams across the region.

Your Responsibilities:

You identify and develop new sales opportunities through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn, and account-based outreach.

You qualify prospects and book meetings for our Account Executives on Valutico’s Due Diligence Suite – the secure VDR, the AI-powered due diligence assistant, and the integrated valuation and analysis capabilities.

You research target accounts and live deal activity to identify firms running M&A processes and the people who own the data room decision.

You engage senior stakeholders across:

M&A advisory and investment banking

Private Equity & Venture Capital

Corporate finance and corporate development teams

Audit, tax advisory, and consulting firms

You speak credibly about how data rooms are used in practice – Q&A management, indexing, permissioning, deal timelines – and where an AI-native room changes the work.

You carefully maintain our CRM database with all relevant lead and prospect information.

You track your own KPIs and actively contribute to achieving team goals.

Requirements

What you need:

1–2 years of experience prospecting into or selling Virtual Data Rooms, due diligence platforms, or M&A workflow software (Datasite, Ansarada, Intralinks, iDeals, Drooms, FirmRoom, SecureDocs, DealRoom, or similar). This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.

A working understanding of how an M&A process runs and where a data room sits within it.

1–3 years of overall experience in B2B sales or sales development, ideally in SaaS.

Existing contacts in the M&A advisory, private equity, investment banking, or corporate development communities are a strong plus.

Comfort opening conversations with senior stakeholders such as Partners, Directors, Investment Professionals, and Corporate Development teams.

Fluency in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to hold a conversation in a high-trust, high-stakes environment.

Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail, and the discipline to keep a CRM clean.

A proactive mindset – able to work independently in a remote, international setting as well as collaboratively within a team.

A positive attitude and a strong drive to meet and exceed sales targets.

Benefits

What we offer:

A category-expanding product at the intersection of VDR, AI, and financial workflows.

A strong, experienced sales team you can learn from – with ongoing support, honest feedback, and a real team spirit.

Structured onboarding and a clear path toward an Account Executive seat for those who earn it.

A modern, data-driven sales stack with automation-first tooling.

Clear targets that we consistently hit – in an environment that recognises and rewards performance.

An international, remote-first work environment with colleagues from around the globe.

Fair and transparent compensation – a competitive base salary and an above-average, uncapped commission structure.

Why This Role Is Different:

You are not just selling a Virtual Data Room.

You are selling a next-generation deal execution platform that combines:

Secure data rooms

AI native due diligence

Integrated valuation and financial analysis tools

This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional VDR sales and help redefine how deals are executed globally.

title: Product Marketing Manager
location: Belgium, Canada, Germany, Netherlands, Poland, Spain, United Kingdom
description:
Help build the future of digital intelligence

At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights.

Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data.

Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to define how Matomo is positioned, understood and brought to market as we strengthen our go-to-market motion and expand our reach with larger organisations.

You will connect customer and market insight with Product, Marketing and Sales, sharpening our positioning and Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), turning product capabilities into compelling customer value, and ensuring teams have the messaging, launches and enablement they need to drive adoption and revenue.

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of product marketing at Matomo, shape how we compete in a rapidly evolving analytics market and make our value clear to customers around the world.

Why this role matters

Matomo has built a globally recognised product on the foundations of open source, privacy and data ownership. As we grow, we need to become equally strong at explaining why Matomo matters, who it matters most to and why organisations should choose us over the alternatives.

Product Marketing sits at the centre of that challenge.

You will bring together customer insight, market intelligence, product strategy and commercial priorities to create a clear and differentiated story, and make sure that story translates into successful launches, stronger sales conversations and greater product adoption.

Your work will directly influence:

Market positioning and differentiation: making Matomo's value clear and compelling in a competitive analytics market

Revenue and sales effectiveness: helping Sales engage the right customers with stronger narratives, evidence and enablement

Product adoption and growth: ensuring customers understand the value of new and existing capabilities and are motivated to use them

What you will own

Positioning and messaging: Define and continuously strengthen Matomo's positioning, messaging and value propositions, translating technical capabilities into clear customer and business value.

Customer and market insight: Build a systematic understanding of our customers, buyers and markets using customer research, sales conversations, support feedback, product usage and market intelligence. Turn those insights into stronger ICPs and personas, messaging, go-to-market decisions and actionable input for Product.

Go-to-market strategy: Own product marketing strategy and planning for key product and feature launches, partnering with Product, Sales and Marketing from early positioning through launch and adoption.

Prioritisation and commercial judgement: Make informed trade-offs across product launches, sales opportunities, customer needs and strategic marketing priorities, focusing product marketing effort where it can create the greatest customer and business impact.

Sales enablement: Give Sales the narratives, competitive intelligence and tools they need to sell effectively across acquisition, expansion and renewal, including pitch materials, battlecards, persona guidance and value/ROI frameworks.

Market and competitive intelligence: Build a strong understanding of the analytics market, customer needs and competitive landscape, turning insight into recommendations for positioning, packaging, pricing, product strategy and go-to-market decisions.

Product adoption: Partner across Marketing, Product and Customer teams to improve how customers discover, understand and adopt Matomo's capabilities throughout their lifecycle.

Message consistency: Ensure Matomo's product story is expressed consistently across our website, campaigns, content, launches and sales conversations, while adapting it appropriately for priority markets and audiences.

Success in this role will be visible through stronger market differentiation, more effective sales conversations, improved conversion and measurable adoption of the products and features you bring to market.

What you bring

5+ years experience in product marketing in a B2B SaaS or technology environment, with a track record of owning positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategy.

Strong experience turning customer, market and competitive insight into clear ICPs, value propositions and differentiated product narratives.

Demonstrated success leading go-to-market initiatives and product launches across Product, Marketing and Sales.

Experience building sales enablement that improves the quality of customer conversations and supports measurable commercial outcomes.

The ability to understand complex or technical products and translate them into simple, credible and compelling customer value.

A customer-centric and data-informed approach, with the ability to combine qualitative insight, quantitative evidence and commercial judgement.

Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment.

A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes.

Helpful experienc

Experience with web analytics, MarTech, data infrastructure, privacy technology or another technically complex SaaS category.

Experience marketing open-source or developer-influenced products.

Experience supporting enterprise or Sales-Led Growth motions.

Experience adapting positioning and enablement across international markets, particularly Europe and North America.

French or German language skills.

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact.

Why Matomo?

Matomo is for people who want their work to matter.

You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms.

We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next.

We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it.

High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution.

You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes.

We also protect focused work through:

No-meeting Fridays

No more than two days each week with late meetings

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant.

Benefits

100% remote working within your country of employment

Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role

25 - 30 days of paid annual leave plus national public holidays

Home-office equipment and co-working support

Health insurance support, where applicable

Mental-health and wellbeing support

Training and professional development opportunities

Paid volunteering day

Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment.

Hiring process

Application → Screening → People & Culture interview → Head of Marketing interview → Take-home exercise with the marketing team

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Matomo values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.

Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere.

title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Analytics (Denmark)
description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, data analysis, managing timelines)

Leverage data and analytics to deliver insights and business solutions, powered by Veeva’s Data Cloud

Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, process, and analytics

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:

3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience

Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

An analytical type of person who loves digging into numbers and other data to find insights

A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions

Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or a comparable coding language

High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company

High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees

Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test

Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not

The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.

Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward

You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

Starting Salary: 600,000 DKK

After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates should be legally authorized to be employed in the EU.

Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

title: Staff Software Engineer, iOS Platform
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The iOS Platform team’s mission is to provide best-in-class experience for iOS development at Airbnb to empower engineers to deliver innovative solutions with high velocity and quality at scale.

We’re ambitious in our vision, and our work spans a large surface area, from frameworks and tooling to build systems, CI, Testing, and AI automations. We maintain and evolve the core libraries & frameworks that underlie most of the Airbnb iOS app and enable product engineers to build great features. Our application is nearly 100% written in Swift and we adopt the latest Apple technologies including SwiftUI, Swift Macros, Swift Testing, and structured concurrency.

The Difference You Will Make:

In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving projects that improve AI agents’ effectiveness across the software development workflow by providing the right tools to get work done efficiently and reliably, with high-quality results.

A Typical Day:

Collaborate with team members & cross functional partners to identify opportunities for improving our developers’ productivity.

Drive roadmap projects and deliver high-quality results to further our mission.

Improve our existing frameworks & toolings to deliver on our ambitious vision.

Your Expertise:

9+ years of industry experience in software development.

Experience building reliable developer tooling in Go.

Experience working with Ruby and maintaining or improving existing tooling.

Experience leveraging Agentic AI to improve software development workflows and drive large scale migrations.

Experience identifying and addressing inefficiencies in AI agent workflows to improve execution time, token efficiency, reliability, and quality.

Experience working in medium- to large-scale codebases.

iOS development experience in Swift, including building applications, libraries, and frameworks.

[Nice to have] Experience designing and developing build systems (e.g. Bazel).

Ability to travel to the San Francisco office for about a week each quarter for gatherings.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$212,000—$265,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

title: Director, Grant Management
description:
Department: Finance

Reports to: AVP, 988 Fiscal Strategy and Grants Management

Location: Remote

Salary Range: $115,200 - $168,300

Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.

Position Overview:

The Director, Grant Management is responsible for coordinating federal grants, with particular responsibility for SAMHSA awards supporting the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. The Director oversees pre-award planning, organization, budget preparation, post-award administration, reporting, procurement, and closeout; ensures grants comply with funding-agency requirements, organizational policies, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), 2 CFR Part 300, and other applicable federal regulations; and aligns grant operations across Finance, Program, Operations, and executive leadership. The role supervises the Grants Manager and strengthens the systems, controls, and processes that support audit readiness and continuity of 988 services.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Oversee all aspects of 988 federal grant management, including responses to funder requests, reporting, and tracking of grant deliverables.

Lead coordination of pre-award planning, organization, and budget preparation, and the post-award administration and closeout of grants.

Manage the grants team to ensure compliance with SAMHSA requirements, 2 CFR Part 200, 2 CFR Part 300, other applicable regulations, organizational policies, award terms, and reporting requirements.

Oversee day-to-day business operations associated with 988 fiscal and grant activities, ensuring effective coordination across Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to support operational efficiency, compliance, and continuity of services.

Oversee the review, approval, and processing of invoices related to 988 federal grants, contracts, and vendor payments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timely submission, appropriate supporting documentation, and compliance with SAMHSA requirements, Uniform Guidance, and organizational financial policies.

Provide oversight of procurement and contract activities tied to federal grant funding, ensuring proper documentation and alignment with both federal and organizational policies.

Oversee the preparation, coordination, and timely submission of required federal reports, including performance, progress, and financial reports, to SAMHSA.

Partner with Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to align grant strategy, manage budgets, and ensure compliance across departments.

Review and approve financial reconciliations and reclassification requests related to 988 grants and operational expenditures, ensuring accuracy, appropriate allocation of costs, compliance with federal grant requirements, and alignment with organizational financial policies and reporting standards

Maintain audit readiness by strengthening systems, controls, records, and supporting documentation and addressing compliance risks and corrective actions promptly.

Serve as the primary liaison to SAMHSA’s Grants Management Specialist and the 988 Government Project Officer, as directed by the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management.

Meet weekly with the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management, to provide updates, highlight strengths and progress, and identify critical gaps or risks.

Translate high-level Lifeline/988 policy goals, award requirements, and strategic priorities into clear, actionable initiatives for direct reports.

Partner with direct reports on performance management, regular developmental reviews, training, coaching, and clear accountability.

Create mentorship and apprenticeship opportunities that support teammates in developing as leaders within Lifeline/988.

Engage in professional development activities, including leadership and DEIB training.

Other duties as assigned

Required Skills/Abilities:

Skilled in managing relationships with federal funders and internal teams

High emotional intelligence and professionalism in diverse stakeholder settings

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Strong time management, organization, and project prioritization skills

Strategic thinker with effective delegation and decision-making skills

Basic understanding of accounting and use of financial data

Solution-focused approach to challenges and team leadership

Interest or experience in mental health, suicide prevention, or the nonprofit sector preferred

Outstanding written and verbal communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree

Master’s degree in healthcare, public health, policy, or a social science field, such as an MPH, MPA, MSW, or another health-related degree, preferred.

7+ years of progressively responsible professional experience managing federal grants, including substantial post-award compliance responsibility.

Demonstrated leadership experience in a relevant field, including strategic planning, outreach and engagement, staff development, and cross-functional work.

Experience managing relationships with federal funders and overseeing budgeting, reporting, procurement, and post-award compliance for federally funded programs.

Physical Requirements:

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.

Will frequently communicate over video calls with internal and external stakeholders to provide status updates and potential roadblocks.

We determine base pay through a comprehensive review of skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and other relevant factors. The range listed reflects the compensation parameters for the role and does not represent the full compensation package. A complete overview of compensation and benefits will be provided by the Talent Acquisition team during the hiring process.

Full time employees will be eligible for excellent comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, supplemental income insurance, employer paid disability insurance, employer paid life insurance, pre-tax FSA for medical and dependent care, and 401K available.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they are able to perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. Vibrant will consider any equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Vibrant Emotional Health is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, creed, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national origin, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, caregiver status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Please be aware that fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers may be circulated on the Internet in an attempt to obtain privileged information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Vibrant does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page and all communications from the Vibrant recruiting team and/or hiring managers will be from an @vibrant.org email address.

description:

Discovery Life Sciences (Discovery) is a leading provider of highly characterized human biospecimens and cellular starting materials to advance cell and gene therapy and precision medicine programs for cancer, infectious disease, and other complex conditions. We routinely manage hundreds of studies and expertly test thousands of biospecimens simultaneously. Leading biopharma, diagnostic and academic institutions trust us to quickly deliver high-quality biospecimens and reliable, reproducible biomarker data, so they can outpace their competition and push the leading edge of innovation using our Science at your Service TM business model.

Discovery Life Sciences is a trusted provider of bioanalytic and biospecimen services to hundreds of customers across the U.S. and around the world. Prospect and source potential new pharma and biotech customers to sell genomics, immunochemistry (IHC), proteomics, and flow cytometry services

Pitch and present Discovery Life Sciences research services and solutions using professional selling skills

Coordinate large, strategic meetings between customer’s senior scientific leadership and appropriate Company leadership to win large-scale projects with substantial revenue potential

Collaborate with scientific SMEs to obtain sales contracts

Ability to build and nurture relationships with large pharma clients and potential clients

Ability to work independently and as part of a cohesive team

Team-first attitude and passion to achieve Commercial Team and company-wide goals

Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills

Present and help evaluate the workability of client projects with Discovery Life Sciences’ procurement Feasibility team, Scientific leadership team, and internal and external collaborators

Productively manage an opportunity pipeline (25-50+ open opportunities) and Feasibility case queue with updated next steps and feedback from customers

Consistently advance calls and win business by setting clear next steps and properly executing them

Use logic, reason, and scientific acumen to close deals instead of relying on discounts

Report market intel back to team (Management, Business Unit Leadership, Sales, Marketing, etc.) by documenting sales calls and client feedback

Work cooperatively with inside sales support professionals, Global Account Managers, fellow Business Development Directors, Marketing, and Feasibility to maximize sales success in assigned territory

Generate a variety of reports for clients as needed

Respect the privacy of the personal information of patients, co-workers, and all individuals with whom the Company interacts

title: Business Development Representative, Emphasys HFA
description:
Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

At Emphasys HFA (Housing Finance Agency), a division of Emphasys, we build and support the only end-to-end financial software in the U.S. dedicated to affordable housing. As the largest full-service provider in this space, we enable State Housing Finance Agencies and other public organizations to administer programs that help families access affordable homeownership or rental housing. Our solutions power the financial backbone that processes funding, manages compliance, and ensures every dollar of support is tracked and maximized.

Who we need

Reporting to the Strategic Account Executive, we are hiring a Business Development Representative to support Emphasys HFA's growth and expand the capacity of our sales function. As our new Business Development Representative, you will combine targeted business development with hands-on support across RFPs, contracts, customer opportunities, and the early stages of the sales process. You will research the HFA market, identify new contacts and opportunities across existing and prospective accounts, coordinate information across Product, Client Services, Marketing, and other teams, and help move opportunities forward. Over time, as you build your knowledge and confidence, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of smaller product sales opportunities from initial conversation through close.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States. Eastern or Central Time zones are preferred.

What’s in it for you

Purpose and impact. You will represent technology that supports Housing Finance Agencies and public organizations delivering affordable homeownership and rental housing programs. Your work will help connect these organizations with the software they rely on to manage the financial and operational backbone of their programs, giving you a clear connection between the relationships you build, the solutions you introduce, and the communities those organizations serve.

A foundation for a long-term sales career. You will gain experience well beyond prospecting, working alongside experienced Sales, Marketing, Client Services, and Product teams and gaining exposure to customer relationships, RFPs, contracts, cross-sell opportunities, and the full sales cycle. As you build your knowledge and demonstrate your ability to manage opportunities, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of smaller product sales from start to close and continue expanding your responsibilities. As part of Constellation Software, you will also be joining a broader organization with opportunities to grow your career over time.

Specialized expertise in an evolving technology market. Emphasys has an established presence in a highly specialized market, with relationships across Housing Finance Agencies and multiple solutions that create opportunities to deepen and expand customer partnerships. You will build valuable expertise in affordable housing technology and public-sector sales while working for a business that is becoming increasingly AI-forward, giving you the opportunity to use modern tools in your research and sales work and learn how emerging technology can support customers and shape the market.

How you will make an impact

Create new opportunities. You will research the HFA market, identify prospective contacts and untapped opportunities, and use targeted outreach to create meaningful conversations. You will also work with existing customer relationships to identify opportunities to introduce additional Emphasys HFA products to teams and departments that may not currently use them.

Move opportunities forward. You will qualify interest, understand customer needs, identify the right stakeholders, and connect opportunities with the Strategic Account Executive when they are ready for deeper sales engagement. You will nurture relationships with longer timelines and continue building knowledge until an opportunity is ready to progress.

Coordinate RFP responses. You will help identify relevant RFP opportunities and coordinate the information needed to respond. You will work with Product Managers and other internal teams to gather answers, build response matrices, organize documentation, and keep the process moving through detailed and complex government procurement requirements.

Support contracts and customer opportunities. You will help organize contract documentation and follow up on items such as insurance certificates and other required materials. You will support the process without owning pricing or final commercial decisions, ensuring the right information is gathered and the opportunity continues moving toward completion.

Take ownership of smaller opportunities. As you build your product knowledge and demonstrate your ability to manage the process, you will have the opportunity to take smaller, lower-value product opportunities from initial conversation through close. This will give you hands-on experience managing the full sales cycle and building confidence as a technology sales professional.

Bring market insight back to the team. You will listen carefully to prospects and customers, stay curious about changing HFA needs, and share what you are learning with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Client Services. Your observations will help the team understand where opportunities exist and how Emphasys can better engage the market.

Use technology to work smarter. You will use CRM, LinkedIn, sales and research tools, and AI-enabled technology to research accounts, organize information, prepare outreach, and work more efficiently. You will look for practical ways technology can improve your approach to business development.

You bring

The sales foundation. You have experience in business development, sales development, lead generation, inside sales, account development, or a related customer-facing role. You may also be earlier in your sales career with other professional experience that demonstrates your interest in building a career in technology sales.

The curiosity and critical thinking. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and genuinely want to understand how a customer operates before deciding how to engage them. You can look at a complex situation, identify what needs to happen next, and work through the steps rather than stopping at the first obstacle.

The drive. You are comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to appear. You can handle unanswered outreach and rejection without losing momentum, while staying persistent, professional, and thoughtful in your follow-up.

The organization. You can manage multiple opportunities, follow up with different stakeholders, keep documentation accurate, and stay on top of details. You are comfortable coordinating information across teams and know that moving an opportunity forward often requires persistence and follow-through.

The communication and collaboration. You can build rapport with different types of stakeholders and communicate clearly in writing and conversation. You enjoy working with Product, Client Services, Marketing, and Sales rather than operating independently, and you know how to seek out the right person when you need information or support.

The technology mindset. You are comfortable learning new technology and interested in using AI and digital tools to improve how you research, communicate, and work. Experience with CRM, LinkedIn, sales engagement platforms, or software sales is an asset.

The market knowledge. Experience in housing, affordable housing, Housing Finance Agencies, government, or technology is an asset. We are also open to someone with strong sales potential who wants to develop expertise in this specialized market.

Join us.

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role, the team’s culture and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

A virtual interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your sales experience, approach to business development, curiosity, and ability to work through complex opportunities.

A final virtual interview with the General Manager, focused on your approach to collaboration, growth, and the opportunity to contribute to the sales function.

Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Fort Lauderdale, FL, USA
description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on

Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests

Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work

Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them

Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows

A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does

A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster

The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally

Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for

Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec

Excellent communication skills

Bonus

Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects

Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

title: Purchasing & Logistics Manager
description:
Our client is hiring a Purchasing & Logistics Manager to own purchase orders and shipments across a supply chain that spans China, Europe and the US. Components come from suppliers in China, Europe and the US and are assembled in Los Angeles; hair colour is formulated and filled in Spain and the US, and finished cartridges ship to salons in the UK and the US every month. They are now launching in the US.

You will be the person who makes sure every PO is confirmed, every shipment moves and every import clears. This is a hands-on role in a small team: you place the orders, chase the confirmations, book the freight and fix what goes wrong.

What you'll do

Purchase orders

Raise POs for components, machined parts, bulk hair colour, cartridges, packaging and consumables in the MRP system.

Get written order confirmations from every supplier with price, quantity and delivery date, and chase until you have them.

Track open POs against confirmed dates; escalate slippage early and agree recovery plans with suppliers.

Match supplier invoices to POs and receipts, and flag discrepancies to finance Shipments (the bulk of the role).

Book and manage inbound and outbound freight: sea, air and road, from China, Europe and the US into the US and UK operations.

Prepare commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and dangerous-goods paperwork; our cartridges are aerosols (UN 1950), so DG compliance is routine, not occasional.

Work with customs brokers and freight forwarders on US and UK import entries, HS classification, origin and duties.

Run the monthly salon replenishment shipments with the 3PLs in the US and the UK.

Set up and manage reverse logistics for empty cartridges from salons.

Keep inventory and in-transit stock accurate across the warehouse, 3PLs and contract fillers.

Suppliers and systems

Be the day-to-day contact for the contract manufacturer, machine shops, fillers, extruders and packaging suppliers.

Maintain supplier records, lead times, MOQs and pricing in the MRP system.

Report weekly on open POs, inbound shipments and stock cover.

Requirements

Must have

5+ years in purchasing, supply chain or logistics for a physical product, with at least 2 years running international shipments.

Hands-on US operations experience: US customs entries, US freight forwarders and carriers, domestic LTL/parcel.

Import/export experience on both sides: you have cleared goods into the US and shipped goods out of it.

Experience managing POs end to end: raising, confirming, expediting and receiving.

Comfortable with incoterms, HS codes, commercial documentation and landed-cost thinking.

Organised and persistent: you keep a clean tracker and you chase until you get an answer.

Fluent English; able to work across US and UK time zones.

Nice to have

Dangerous-goods (aerosol / hazmat) shipping experience, IATA/IMDG/49 CFR.

Experience sourcing and importing from Chinese and European suppliers, including sea-freight consolidation.

Experience with an MRP/ERP system for purchasing and inventory.

Experience in a start-up or small manufacturing company where you built the process rather than inherited it.

title: Social Media Content Manager
description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for an autonomous, growth-minded Social Media Content Manager to take 100% ownership of our US Instagram presence (along with Threads & LinkedIn). In this role, you won't just post content - you’ll own the entire strategy: revamping our profile storefront for a tech-savvy audience and building a seamless bridge between high-performing Meta Ads and our profile content to turn visitors into buyers.

What you will do

Own the Social Media Channels: Take full end-to-end ownership of our Instagram account, extending distribution to Threads and LinkedIn to drive audience engagement in the US market.

Repackage the Instagram Storefront: Revamp profile highlights, pinned posts, and top-of-feed content to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

Bridge Ads to Profile: Sync social content with active Meta Ad campaigns, ensuring users landing from ads see consistent messaging, proof points, and value promises that drive conversions.

Build & Execute the Content Strategy: Create and manage a structured content calendar featuring high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, interactive posts, and compelling copy).

Direct Creative Production: Set clear briefs and collaborate seamlessly with in-house copywriters, graphic designers, and SEO managers to produce high-quality assets.

Track & Optimize Metrics: Monitor core engagement metrics (saves, shares, reach, ER) and continuously iterate on content tactics based on data and audience feedback.

Requirements

Channel Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of the Instagram account (with cross-posting to Threads and LinkedIn), driving content strategy, execution, and engagement for our US audience.

Profile Packaging & Value Proposition: Re-pack and maintain the Instagram storefront (Highlights, pinned posts, and top feed) to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.

Ad-to-Profile Funnel Matching: Align social content with active performance marketing campaigns (Meta Ads) to ensure a seamless post-click user journey that reinforces ad promises and drives conversion.

Content Planning & Execution: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar tailored to a tech-savvy, English-speaking audience, focusing on high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, copy).

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Brief and direct internal team members (copywriters, graphic designers, SEO managers) and external creative vendors (motion designers) to produce high-quality assets.

Performance Tracking: Monitor key social metrics (engagement rate, saves, shares, reach) and iterate on content strategy based on data and audience feedback.

What we can offer you

100% Remote: Freedom to work from anywhere (Europe, LATAM, Georgia, Serbia, etc.)

Full Ownership & Creative Freedom: End-to-end ownership of the social media channels with room to test new ideas, experiment with formats, and directly influence conversion metrics.

Strong Team Support: Dedicated internal resources at your disposal, including graphic designers, copywriters, and SEO managers to help execute your vision.

International Impact: Hands-on experience scaling social channels for a fast-growing EdTech product in the US market.

Dynamic Startup Environment: Fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers and modern AI/marketing tools.

They are seeking an all-round Senior Data Engineer to join their Data Services team. In this role, you will design, maintain, and enhance the critical data infrastructure that powers analytics and operations across the organization. This includes managing the data lake, operational databases, high-volume batch and real-time processing systems, and metadata repositories—all working in concert to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists to structure schemas and design data models, work with product teams to integrate new data sources, and partner with fellow engineers to bring cutting-edge data technologies to life.

The Ideal Candidate

Our client values logical thinkers who balance respect for best practices with independent critical thinking. They seek professionals who are adaptable, capable of owning projects from end-to-end, communicate effectively in English, and thrive in collaborative, high-performing team environments. While deep experience in specific technologies is valued, they prioritize candidates who are eager to learn, grow, and fill any gaps on the job.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and Maintain Data Infrastructure: Build, optimize, and manage the data lake and its associated processing frameworks, ensuring reliable and scalable data ingestion from diverse sources.

Design and Orchestrate ETL Pipelines: Architect and implement robust data workflows using orchestration tools, moving data from source systems through various processing stages into the lake.

Enable Analytics and Data Science: Structure data schemas and design data models to support business intelligence, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.

Integrate New Data Sources: Work with product and engineering teams to onboard new data streams, ensuring seamless integration and data quality.

Champion Technology Evolution: Evaluate and introduce emerging tools and frameworks to continuously improve the data platform's performance and capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Data Engineering Expertise: Solid understanding of data lake architectures and experience working with columnar big data databases (e.g., Athena, Redshift, Vertica, Hive/Hadoop). Familiarity with Iceberg is a significant advantage.

ETL & Workflow Orchestration: Proven ability to design and implement ETL pipelines and manage workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, Luigi, or AWS Batch.

Programming Proficiency: Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience using relevant libraries (e.g., boto3, pandas, pytest). PySpark experience is highly desirable.

Cloud & AWS Services: Practical experience with cloud environments—particularly AWS (Glue, EMR, EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch) or equivalent platforms.

Containerization & Orchestration: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes (or AWS ECS/EKS) for deployment and scaling.

CI/CD & Version Control: Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline) and solid git practices (branching strategies, collaboration workflows).

Agile Methodologies: Comfortable working within Agile/Lean frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban.

Bonus Skills (Highly Valued):

Distributed messaging and streaming systems (Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ)

Streaming processing frameworks (Spark Streaming, Apache Beam, Apache Flink)

Metadata catalogue and lineage tools (Amundsen, Apache Atlas, Alation)

JVM languages (Java, Scala, Kotlin) and related frameworks

RDBMS/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis)

BI tools (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, QuickSight)

Logging and monitoring stacks (ELK, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)

Data privacy and security concepts (encryption, tokenization, Apache Ranger)

Experience Level

This is a senior position (L3–L4 level). Candidates with approximately 3+ years of relevant data engineering experience are encouraged to apply. What matters most is the quality of experience—our client values professionals who have worked in environments that foster continuous learning and skill development. Length of tenure alone is not a differentiator; they seek individuals who can demonstrate meaningful growth and technical progression throughout their careers.

The Role

We're hiring a hands-on Paid Media Specialist to run our day-to-day ad operations on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat. Meta is our main channel today, and TikTok and Snapchat are growing fast.

This is not a content creation role. Our in-house creator produces the videos; you'll prepare them for each platform, launch them, track them and help us find the winners. Launch and operations

Load 10–12 new video ads per week into test campaigns across Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, working toward two or three launches a week.

Optimization

Read test results against our internal playbook and identify winners and losers.

Move winners into scaling campaigns and adjust budgets.

Retest underperformers with new combinations of videos and copy.

Work with attribution events, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.

Compare performance across platforms and flag what works where.

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think and work than about years on your CV.

Must-haves

Recent, hands-on experience launching ads yourself in Meta Ads Manager. A few months is enough.

Solid grasp of core metrics such as CTR, CPC and CPA, and what a campaign is optimizing for.

Strong organization and attention to detail when handling high volumes of assets.

Self-managed and proactive: you work from one daily check-in and come with your own proposals, not just questions.

Comfortable using AI tools to work faster, while still forming and sharing your own conclusions.

Professional English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in TikTok Ads Manager and Snapchat Ads Manager.

Experience with ad approvals and appeals in health, wellness or other regulated categories.

Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics or ad attribution.

DTC or e-commerce experience.

title: Sales Development Representative - Nordics
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

If you’re looking to start and grow your career in a challenging, fast-paced, innovative environment, you’ve come to the right place. Veeva’s Sales Development Program (SDP) is a rigorous, comprehensive track dedicated to developing talents into industry-leading Account Partners.

Ultimately, our teams generate opportunities and build relationships with the world’s leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. We believe that to best serve our customers in this capacity it’s important to deeply understand Veeva’s products, the industry, and consulting and sales skills.

As the Sales Development Representative (SDR) for Veeva, you will be evangelizing Veeva to pharma companies in Europe. Your responsibilities include marketing plans, generating and qualifying opportunities, collaborating with many internal and external stakeholders, and developing into an expert on Products, Industry Processes, and Culture.

This is not a normal sales development role! During the program, you will be responsible for the full sales process and be exposed to continuous opportunities.

Lay the foundations for a successful career in sales & accelerate your development at a fast pace!

What You'll Do

Gain expertise in consulting, product, industry, and sales to become an industry-leading Account Partner

Learn and executive a consultative sales methodology

Work within a defined territory to generate and qualify new leads and opportunities

Research and develop a plan for breaking into your assigned accounts

Partner closely with sales teams to advance and close your opportunities over time

Build trusted relationships with customers, understand their needs, and recommend the right Veeva products and solutions

Rapidly develop your sales skills on the job and through training and events

Requirements

2+ years of professional experience

Experience in Sales development in Technology and/or Life Sciences

Fluent in Danish & English

Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills

Team-first mentality with proven success

Self-starter, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative

Willingness to travel as needed (~25%)

Experience in Consulting, Customer Success, or Project Management

Work anywhere
