title: Strategic Markets Editor - Critical Minerals, Americas
description:
The Role

The Strategic Markets Editor leverages deep expertise and experience in non-ferrous markets, including critical minerals, to help shape Fastmarkets’ PRA strategy in this area, driving the development of prices, market-leading content and industry engagement. The role produces high-value strategic content, builds senior market and political relationships and acts as an ambassador for the Fastmarkets brand. A pivotal role at the heart of Fastmarkets editorial, this is a highly collaborative leadership position without direct line management responsibilities.

Principal accountabilities

The Strategic Markets Editor leverages deep expertise and experience in critical minerals to help shape Fastmarkets’ PRA strategy in this area, driving the development of prices, market-leading content and industry engagement. The role produces high-value strategic content, builds senior market and political relationships and acts as an ambassador for the Fastmarkets brand. A pivotal role at the heart of Fastmarkets editorial, this is a highly collaborative leadership position without direct line management responsibilities.

Principal accountabilities

Identifies opportunities for and produces high-value strategic content, including insightful market reporting, in-depth analysis, interviews and commentary, to drive market engagement and strengthen Fastmarkets’ profile in critical minerals.

Helps expand Fastmarkets’ presence and reputation in areas where the business aims to grow

Identifies opportunities for new price launches and product development, including helping to determine specifications, methodology and data submission pools

Builds trusted relationships with policymakers, regulators and other public-sector stakeholders to deepen market understanding and inform authoritative editorial coverage, while maintaining editorial independence and avoiding advocacy.

Works with the broader business to plan market engagement and helps lead efforts to strengthen relationships with market participants, using Fastmarkets’ insight and expertise to deliver value to customers

Produces, coordinates and edits strategic content across markets in a joined-up way to maximise impact

Shares knowledge and feedback widely, guides and mentors reporters, strengthens market understanding across the team and helps colleagues build their own profile, while providing strategic and functional direction

Assesses and approves prices as required, helping to ensure all prices produced by reporters meet Fastmarkets’ and relevant regulatory standards

Aligns strategic content with marketing and across customer-facing channels, including editorial, events, client presentations and meetings

Strengthens Fastmarkets’ reputation for market-leading expertise and insight by serving as a brand ambassador at Fastmarkets’ and external events. This includes supporting the development of events, planning content, attracting high-profile speakers, speaking on stage and moderating panels

Helps raise Fastmarkets’ profile across external channels, including social media, to showcase expertise and build market interest

Key interfaces

Reports to Editorial Director. Partners with other editors to define and plan priorities for strategic content and customer engagement

Engages with reporters and Editorial Enablement to guide and support a joined-up approach to high-impact strategic content

Collaborates to support Events team to grow delegate lists and create compelling agendas, maximising the reach and impact of content-led events

Aligns content strategy with the goals of the Marketing team, ensuring consistency of message and strength of impact

Works with Product teams to align and showcase the value of content through customer-facing products and platforms, driving adoption and engagement

Engages with Research to produce content aligned with internal forecasting and market insight, enhancing relevance and value

Partners with Editorial and Pricing Enablement to support the pricing and content delivered by the team

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven and passionate about being part of a fast-paced, successful team. The successful candidate will be a strong team player, comfortable working flexibly and operating effectively across a global, matrixed organisation.

Strong expertise in critical minerals

Experience of working in a PRA and/or in commodity markets

Excellent journalism and editing skills

A strong network of contacts and credible, relevant industry relationships

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, share expertise, mentor junior colleagues and build strong working relationships across teams

Strong understanding of pricing, price discovery and methodology, with the ability to contribute to benchmark development and market engagement

Ability to operate effectively at senior levels internally within a matrix management structure and externally with market participants and other stakeholders

Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify market opportunities, emerging trends and areas for growth

Excellent analytical skills, including the ability to assess market developments, customer needs and competitive dynamics

Sound commercial awareness and the ability to connect editorial and pricing activity to broader business priorities

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively not just with editorial colleagues, but with product, events, marketing, research and commercial teams

Strong project management and organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing market conditions and business needs

Strong influencing skills, including the ability to lead through expertise and credibility in teams without direct reporting lines

Excellent communication skills and the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and persuasively to both internal and external audiences

High levels of integrity, sound judgement and commitment to ethical decision-making

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance

ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done

GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency

INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.

CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do

COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

If the position is listed as remote this opportunity is available to applicants based in the following states:

• Illinois

• Oregon

• New York

• Pennsylvania

• Texas*

* Denotes states with office locations to support hybrid working.

Otherwise the position will be located as shown in the advert.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 700 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond.

You will own the operational foundation that supports employees across multiple countries, ensuring HR processes are accurate, compliant, and scalable as the company grows.

What You Will Need

7+ years of experience in HR Operations, People Operations, or HR Administration

Strong understanding of global HR operations, employment documentation, payroll coordination, HR systems, and compliance

Experience building and improving HR processes in a fast-growing company

Strong operational mindset with high attention to detail

description:
Clinical Documentation & QA Specialist

Location: Remote – South Africa

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Schedule: Monday – Friday

Salary: R 26,500–30,000

About the Role

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and organised Clinical Documentation & QA Specialist to review clinical documentation, identify errors or gaps, and ensure records meet required quality and compliance standards.

This is a hands-on quality assurance role where you will work closely with RBTs, BCBAs and other providers to review documentation, coordinate corrections and ensure issues are resolved accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate is patient, thorough and confident providing constructive feedback. You should be comfortable dealing with pushback and difficult conversations while remaining professional and not taking things personally.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Set up employee and provider profiles within company systems.

Use AI tools to identify session notes that may not meet funder expectations and review flagged issues.

Conduct documentation audits against approved standards and procedures.

Review RBT and BCBA notes for:

Missing goals

Incomplete or overly similar narratives

Signature issues

Incorrect dates or times

Compare documentation against CentralReach billing, service records and schedules to identify discrepancies.

Coordinate corrections with providers and follow up on outstanding changes.

Maintain an accurate audit trail within assigned permissions.

Maintain Excel trackers for new-RBT reviews, recurring errors, amended or removed notes and unresolved corrections.

Review parent/caregiver training utilisation, including service code 97156, against payer-specific expectations and follow up with BCBAs where required.

Support profile, note and timesheet administration.

Assist with CentralReach mobile workflow testing and report system issues.

Train new hires on proper documentation practices and support consistent documentation standards.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be:

Extremely detail-oriented and thorough.

Highly organised with strong follow-through.

Patient and comfortable working through repetitive documentation reviews.

A quick learner who can understand and apply guidance independently.

Confident providing constructive feedback and following up when corrections are required.

Comfortable dealing with resistance or pushback without taking it personally.

Able to identify inconsistencies, errors and missing information accurately.

Strong in written communication and professional when communicating with providers.

Comfortable working with confidential records and sensitive information.

Proficient in Excel and Microsoft Office.

Experience & Qualifications

Healthcare experience or previous CentralReach experience is not required and training can be provided.

However, the following would be advantageous:

Experience in healthcare, clinical administration, quality assurance or documentation review.

Experience with clinical or medical records.

Familiarity with ABA terminology or clinical documentation.

Experience with CentralReach or similar healthcare/clinical systems.

Higher education in psychology, healthcare, medical, clinical or a related field.

No specific clinical licence or mandatory qualification is required.

Software & Tools

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word

SharePoint

Outlook

Microsoft Teams

Zoom

CentralReach – training provided

CentralReach mobile – workflow testing

Important Expectations

This role requires someone who can stand their ground professionally.

You will occasionally deal with RBTs, BCBAs or other providers who may be frustrated or push back when documentation needs to be corrected. The right person needs to be able to remain calm, objective and professional, focus on the requirements, and not take difficult interactions personally.

If you enjoy quality assurance, spotting details others may miss, keeping records accurate and helping teams improve their documentation, this could be a great fit.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist (US, Remote)
description:
Reports to: Controller

Department: Finance

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $58,000 - $69,000

Tier 2 (National Markets): $53,000 - $63,000

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $48,000 - $56,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

As the Accounts Payable Specialist, you’ll help keep our financial operations accurate, timely, and well controlled by owning key activities across the accounts payable cycle for Paleovalley and Wild Pastures. You’ll work across a multi-entity, inventory-driven environment to process vendor bills, resolve discrepancies, maintain clean vendor records, and support accurate month-end reporting in Acumatica.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing order to high-volume details, following issues through to resolution, and partnering closely with Accounting, Supply Chain, Operations and our vendor community.

What You’ll Do

Ensure timely and accurate vendor bill processing in Acumatica across multiple entities, ensuring bills are recorded in the correct company and supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

Perform three-way matching of vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receipts, investigating and resolving price, quantity, receiving, and other discrepancies with Supply Chain, Operations, and vendors.

Manage AP approval workflows, the Acumatica Incoming Documents module, and shared AP inboxes to ensure vendor invoices, bills, and other AP requests are captured, routed, and addressed within established timelines.

Review and code non-PO vendor invoices and other expenses to the appropriate entity, general ledger account, warehouse, and other required dimensions while maintaining accurate supporting documentation.

Apply and allocate landed costs, including freight, processing fees, discounts, and taxes, to purchase order receipts using the appropriate allocation method.

Reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, vendor statements, received-not-invoiced purchase accruals, landed cost clearing accounts, and work-in-progress balances; research and resolve reconciling items.

Support month-end close by preparing accurate and timely AP accruals, aging reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s and banking information, and follow established controls.

Build responsive working relationships with vendors and internal partners, addressing invoice, payment, and account questions promptly and following issues through to resolution.

Support annual 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, audit requests, and other AP-related compliance activities by maintaining complete, organized, and audit-ready records.

Identify practical opportunities to optimize AP processes, controls, and efficiency while maintaining accuracy in a high-volume environment.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

4 - 6 years of hands-on, full-cycle accounts payable experience, ideally in a manufacturing, CPG, distribution, or other inventory-intensive environment.

Hands-on experience working in Acumatica or another large ERP environment, including purchase order, inventory, and accounts payable modules.

Demonstrated experience with three-way matching, landed cost allocations, and resolving invoice, purchase order, and receiving discrepancies.

Strong reconciliation skills, including AP subledger-to-GL, vendor statements, purchase accruals, and related clearing or work-in-progress accounts.

Solid understanding of accrual accounting and the accounts payable month-end close process.

Intermediate Excel skills, including PivotTables and formulas such as VLOOKUP and SUMIFS.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions with competing deadlines.

Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with vendors and cross-functional partners with little direction.

Bonus Points

Associate’s degree or higher in Accounting, Business, or a related field.

Direct experience with Acumatica, particularly within Purchase Order, Inventory, and Accounts Payable modules.

Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, CPG, or a multi-entity environment with multiple warehouses or locations.

Experience supporting 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, or financial audits.

Our Commitment to You

Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost

Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest

Paid sick time for when you need it

Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays

Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees

100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance

Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team

401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service

$300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

This role is open until filled.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Bend, OR, USA
description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on

Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests

Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work

Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them

Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows

A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does

A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster

The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally

Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for

Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec

Excellent communication skills

Bonus

Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects

Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

title: Head of Brand & Creative
description:
ABOUT GOLDEN CHILD

Golden Child is redefining pet nutrition through an uncompromising focus on health, quality, and culinary craftsmanship. A Miami-based startup, we bring together veterinary nutrition expertise, classically trained chefs, and supply chain specialists to develop food held to human-grade standards.

Our chef-crafted, science-backed Mains and functional Drizzles are designed to support lifelong health. We’re building a brand for people whose dogs are family, grounded in the care that goes into their food and the pleasure of the life they share.

THE ROLE

Golden Child is looking for a Head of Brand & Creative to lead the next chapter of the brand and build the team that brings it to life.

You will own Golden Child’s creative direction across packaging, campaigns, content, digital experiences, and physical activations. Your immediate focus will be carrying our evolving brand direction through the rebrand and relaunch, while establishing the creative capabilities we need as the business grows.

Our ambition includes packaging people want in their homes, original films that reveal the people and decisions behind our recipes, and experiences that bring dog owners together. You’ll connect those expressions through a recognizable point of view, with food and the relationship between dogs and their people at the center.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll move between setting brand strategy and shaping the work itself: developing concepts, directing shoots, reviewing packaging proofs, refining copy, and helping the team get projects out into the world.

You will work closely with our CMO and founding team, alongside Growth, Culinary, Veterinary Nutrition, Product, and Operations.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1. BRAND STRATEGY & CREATIVE DIRECTION

- Own Golden Child’s positioning, visual identity, and tone of voice, translating the brand strategy into clear direction the team can use.

- Lead the rebrand across customer touchpoints, preserving what makes Golden Child recognizable while developing its next expression.

- Set the creative standard for design, photography, film, and copy. Make clear decisions and give feedback that improves the work.

2. PACKAGING & PHYSICAL BRAND EXPERIENCE

- Lead creative development across food packaging, shipping materials, and the experience of receiving and serving Golden Child.

- Partner with Product, Operations, and packaging specialists to take designs from concept through artwork, material selection, physical proofs, and production.

- Develop a packaging system that can accommodate new products and future retail channels, with clear product information and a consistent brand identity.

- Guide the design of merchandise and mealtime accessories as those opportunities develop.

3. ORIGINAL CONTENT & STORYTELLING

- Build an editorial and content plan around Golden Child’s food, veterinary nutrition expertise, and the lives people share with their dogs.

- Develop recurring formats, including films that follow our culinary and nutrition teams through recipe development, alongside portraits of owners and their dogs.

- Turn technical expertise into stories people want to watch and can understand. Work with our experts to keep nutritional explanations accurate.

- Plan long-form films and shorter edits together, giving each format a clear purpose across social, the website, email, and paid media.

4. CAMPAIGNS & CREATIVE PERFORMANCE

- Lead campaign concepts and creative execution for the relaunch, product introductions, and ongoing customer acquisition and retention.

- Partner with Growth to develop and test advertising, using performance findings to improve concepts, messaging, and execution.

- Translate larger brand stories into useful assets for each channel, including product pages, customer education, and lifecycle communications.

- Evaluate work against its intended purpose, from audience attention and engagement to conversion and repeat purchase.

5. INFLUENCER, TASTEMAKER & BRAND PARTNERSHIPS

- Help shape the creative direction of Golden Child’s creator and tastemaker programs, helping identify people whose relationship with their dogs makes them a credible fit.

- Work with the CMO and Social Media Lead to develop collaborations that give participants meaningful access to the food and the people behind it, with room for their own perspective.

- Guide partner briefs, content concepts, gifting, and campaign integration in collaboration with the team managing those relationships.

- Identify opportunities across food, hospitality, fashion, beauty, and wellness that fit Golden Child’s audience and brand direction.

6. IRL EVENTS & COMMUNITY EXPERIENCES

- Lead the creative concept and brand expression of pop-ups, dinners, kitchen visits, and other gatherings for people and their dogs.

- Work with internal teams and external partners on the details that shape the experience, including the setting, food presentation, printed materials, and photography.

- Plan how each activation will reach people before and after the event through content and customer follow-up.

- Partner with Growth and Operations to define the objective, budget, and practical requirements before production begins.

7. CREATIVE TEAM & PRODUCTION

- Build and lead a lean internal creative team, supported by specialist freelancers, agencies, and production partners.

- Own creative briefs, production budgets, schedules, and delivery. Establish a reliable process for making ambitious work within an early-stage company.

- Direct photography and video production from concept through casting, crews, locations, post-production, and usage rights.

- Determine which capabilities Golden Child should build internally and where external specialists will make the work stronger.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of experience in brand and creative roles, including leadership of a multidisciplinary team or substantial creative programs.

- A portfolio showing a distinctive point of view and strong execution across several of the following: brand identity, packaging, campaigns, photography, film, and digital.

- Experience building or evolving a consumer brand, ideally in food, beverage, beauty, wellness, fashion, hospitality, or another design-led category.

- Strong art direction and storytelling skills, with the ability to give precise feedback on design and copy.

- Experience taking packaging or other physical brand materials through production.

- Experience commissioning and producing photography and video, with a clear understanding of budgets and the decisions that affect the finished work.

- An understanding of paid creative and how to work with a Growth team without losing the brand’s voice.

- Experience managing internal creatives and external collaborators.

- Comfortable developing the concept and staying involved through the final details.

- Resourceful, decisive, and energized by building at an early stage.

- An interest in food, design, and the relationship between dogs and their people.

Please include a portfolio with your application and explain your role in the work shown.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The rebrand reaches customers through packaging, the website, and campaigns that feel recognizably Golden Child. Our original content makes the care behind the food visible and gives people a reason to return.

You will build a creative team and production process that can sustain that standard as the company grows, with clear priorities, realistic budgets, and work that supports the business.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. At Abbott Electrophysiology (EP), we’ve been a leader for over 20 years, pioneering one of the first mapping systems, introducing the first contact force ablation catheter and creating a portfolio of products trusted in millions of procedures around the world. We have and will continue to redefine what’s possible in an evolving and challenging EP landscape.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

As a Clinical Associate on the U.S. Abbott EP team, you will provide clinical and technical support in a hospital setting, utilizing EP technology in the treatment of various cardiac arrhythmias. You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Additional responsibilities include:

Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application.

Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting.

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business.

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly.

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities.

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems.

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas:

Collaborating with sales personnel;

Facilitating regional training seminars;

Participating in clinical studies/data collection;

Troubleshooting; and,

Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives.

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management.

Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals.

Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development.

Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

title: Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.

We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.

As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you.

We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible.

Key responsibilities

Own growth for how people use Claude in their everyday work, end to end, as your full-time focus

Diagnose what drives deep, habitual use and what blocks it, combining data, research, and hands-on time in the product

Set an opinionated vision for the area and turn it into a roadmap with your PM, engineering, and data science partners

Redesign core parts of the product to drive growth, from onboarding and first-run experiences to the everyday workflows people rely on most

Shape hypotheses and experiments, and judge results with a nuanced view of how we win, not just the topline metric

Deliver exceptionally crafted interactions and set the quality bar for your area

Drive alignment with partner teams whose work touches your area, connecting individual use to team and company adoption

Mentor other designers, and frame problems clearly enough that others can own them

Prototype and test ideas quickly with Claude Code and other AI tools

Minimum qualifications

A portfolio of shipped product design work that shows product vision and a high level of craft

Experience owning growth for a major product area end to end, including diagnosing problems and setting direction

Deep growth design experience in activation, onboarding, retention, engagement, or expansion, on a product at meaningful scale

Hands-on experience designing, launching, and interpreting experiments, and using them to make product decisions

Fluency with product analytics such as funnels, retention, and engagement

Proficiency with design, prototyping, and AI tools, such as Figma and Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science

Preferred qualifications

Experience leading growth strategy across multiple teams or product areas

Experience designing enterprise/B2B SaaS, productivity, or collaboration tools

Experience with product-led growth, from a single user to a team to a company-wide rollout

Experience mentoring designers or shaping a design practice

Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool

Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS)

Experience defining AI-powered workflows for yourself or your team

A clear point of view on when a product should ask for attention, and when it should stay out of the way

Passion for building safe, beneficial AI that helps people do their best work

Representative projects

Diagnose why some people make a product part of their daily work and others drift away, then lead the changes that close the gap

Redesign a core part of the product so people return to it more often and get more value each time

Set the vision for a product's first-run experience and lead it through experiments to a redesigned, permanent flow

Design the path from one person's daily use to their whole team adopting it

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$305,000—$460,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: AI Creative Strategist
description:
Impact Clients is building a new organic growth channel around highly targeted social media pages in the supplement space, each with its own character, audience, voice, and content strategy.

The goal is simple: create genuinely useful content that earns attention organically, builds trust with specific demographics, and ultimately drives supplement sales through relevant affiliate offers.

As our AI Creative Strategist, you’ll own the thinking behind the content: developing new characters and avatars, finding angles that resonate with different audiences, writing hooks and scripts, analyzing what performs, and building a repeatable creative system that can scale across dozens of pages.

This isn’t only a content role.

What we learn from building this division will eventually become part of the curriculum taught inside our education company. You’ll help train our coaches and students on what’s working while also giving direct product feedback to our engineering team on the AI creative tools you use every day.

You’ll be helping build the playbook from zero.

ABOUT IMPACT CLIENTS

Impact Clients is a fast-growing tech-enabled education company helping everyday people build online businesses through a combination of education, coaching, community, and proprietary software.

Our culture is built around clarity, extreme ownership, high standards, and speed of execution.

We move quickly. We expect people to solve problems without constant direction. And we give talented people a significant amount of ownership when they demonstrate they can produce results.

If you thrive in environments where creativity and speed go hand-in-hand, where your work gets implemented immediately, and where you're expected to think like an owner rather than an employee, you'll fit in well here.

This is a fully remote, full-time role.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

A blank canvas. Start from zero and shape the avatars, angles, accounts, and content strategy from the ground up.

A path to leadership. Help build the team as the channel grows, with the opportunity to eventually lead the creative division.

A team around you. Work alongside AI video editors and publishing support so your time stays focused on strategy, copy, and creative direction.

Freedom to test. No ad spend approvals or endless creative bottlenecks. Put ideas into the market, learn what works, and iterate quickly.

Simple production. Let the strength of the idea carry the content without the heavy production requirements often associated with paid creative.

Exposure across three business units. Help build a new supplement division, shape how the playbook is taught inside our education business, and influence the roadmap of our proprietary software.

Real influence beyond your own function. What you discover can become curriculum taught to thousands of students, while your daily use of AI tools helps determine what our engineering team builds next.

WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO - The Day To Day of this Role:

Creating the AI avatars: determine which demographics deserve their own character, what those characters should represent, and which concepts should be killed.

Generate 10–20 new ideas, hooks, and angles every day for short form 7-30 second reels.

Write and direct scripts for 30–60 second organic Reels, then hand them to the AI video editing team for production.

Own what gets tested across 5–10+ Instagram and Facebook accounts, each with its own personality, demographic, and content strategy.

Match message to demographic precisely. A 45-year-old man and a 68-year-old woman should not receive the same hook, framing, or script.

Turn genuinely useful information into content that earns trust first, allowing the offer in the bio to convert second.

Study account-level performance and identify which avatars, hooks, formats, and topics are receiving organic distribution.

Retire weak avatars and scale the characters and concepts that show traction.

Turn winning creative patterns into repeatable systems rather than one-off successes.

Help build the department once the model is proven, including future strategists, editors, and publishing support.

Approximately 10–20% of your time:

Once the model is proven, help build course content for the company's education division

Run a weekly group coaching call helping students apply what we've learned.

Give our software engineering team hands-on feedback about how to improve the internal AI tools you use every day.

WHO YOU ARE

You come from the direct-response Meta advertising world, ideally within supplements, health, wellness, or another performance-driven ecommerce category.

You have produced paid creative at meaningful volume — ideally hundreds or thousands of assets per month.

You are a strong direct-response copywriter, and developing hooks, angles, and concepts is one of your favorite parts of the job.

You've developed messaging for demographics significantly different from your own.

You understand that what moves men aged 40–50 may be completely different from what moves women aged 60–70 — and you know how to adjust the creative accordingly.

You can look at performance data and turn what is working into the next generation of creative ideas.

You are comfortable testing aggressively, killing losing concepts quickly, and doubling down on winners.

You are highly fluent with AI creative tools. Our current stack includes Higgsfield, Google Flow Omni, Openart, and CapCut.

You can operate independently without needing a detailed SOP for every decision.

Ideally, you've also worked on an info-product, course, or coaching-based offer, particularly in the make-money-online or start-an-online-business space (optional, though preferred).

The ideal candidate brings an unusual combination: ecommerce/supplement direct-response experience + strong creative strategy and copywriting + familiarity with info-product or coaching businesses.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In Your First 90 Days On Our Team

30 Days:

Three to five avatars are defined, scripted, and actively in production. A consistent daily idea pipeline exists so the editing team is never waiting on creative direction. The first Reels are live across the initial accounts.

60 Days:

We have a clear understanding of which characters, hooks, topics, and angles Instagram and Facebook are actually distributing. Weak avatars are being retired, winning concepts are being expanded across additional accounts, and each audience is matched to a relevant offer.

90 Days:

A repeatable system exists from avatar brief → creative concept → script → production → published Reel → performance analysis across 5–10+ accounts, without requiring you to manually touch every step.

You should also be able to clearly tell us what the department needs next, where the bottlenecks are, and who we need to hire to continue scaling it.

If this is role is exciting to you, then apply by filling out the questions below. Truly take your time with putting in quality effort into the Loom video, and our team will be in contact with you to schedule interview within 24-48 hours.

Do you want to play a critical role in shaping the future of America’s skies? As the Air Traffic Training SME you’ll design, deliver, and oversee innovative training programs that keep our National Airspace System (NAS) safe, efficient, and ready for the challenges of tomorrow. This is more than just a training role—it’s a leadership opportunity to influence how the next generation of air traffic professionals are prepared. This role is ideal for a training professional ready to step into leadership, expand their influence, and contribute to one of the most mission-critical systems in the country.

This is an Part-Time / On-Call role.

Remote work is permitted; candidates must reside within the contiguous United States.

Must be able to travel 50% of the time to support deployments at CONUS and potentially OCONUS locations.

In this position, you will:

Develop, deliver, and evaluate comprehensive air traffic and technical training programs supporting NAS modernization.

Translate complex FAA operational procedures, system requirements, and technical information into clear, engaging training.

Develop or maintain instructor-led training, virtual learning, simulations, exercises, job aids, and performance-based assessments.

Deliver classroom, virtual, and hands-on instruction to operational and technical personnel.

Provide subject matter expertise regarding FAA air traffic operations, procedures, and NAS environments.

Identify training risks, gaps, and readiness concerns and work with program leadership to develop mitigation strategies.

Maintain accurate training records and drive continuous program improvements.

Every flight depends on well-prepared air traffic professionals. By leading training programs at this scale, you’ll directly impact national aviation safety and efficiency while shaping the careers of those who manage our skies. As an Air Traffic Training SME, you'll help bridge the gap between new technology and operational readiness, ensuring personnel have the knowledge and practical skills needed to support the continued safety, efficiency, and reliability of America's airspace.

U.S. Citizenship Required.

Bachelors degree and 12 years’ relevant experience or Masters degree with 10 years experience or Associates degree with 14 years of experience or HS diploma with 16 years experience.

Strong working knowledge of FAA air traffic control operations, procedures, and terminology.

Strong facilitation, presentation, written communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability and willingness to travel 50% in support of program requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with FAA systems, federal modernization efforts, or mission-critical environments.

Previous experience as an Air Traffic Controller, FAA instructor, training specialist, or air traffic operations SME.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Durham, NC, USA
description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on

Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests

Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work

Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them

Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows

A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does

A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster

The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally

Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for

Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec

Excellent communication skills

Bonus

Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects

Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

About Matter Health 
 Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. As we rapidly expand across the Southeast, we are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments. We Lead with Love in Everything We Do. About the Role Matter Health is seeking a Nurse Practitioner to support older adults in Atlanta, GA. At Matter Health , our NP's are more than just providers — they are Panel Owners. You will manage a dedicated panel of older adults as their ongoing primary care provider, building strong, lasting relationships within the communities you serve. This is a fully community-based position with no traditional clinic home base. Nurse Practitioners regularly travel throughout their assigned market to provide care in affordable housing communities and patients' homes, building strong relationships and ensuring consistent access to care across their designated territory. Nurse Practitioners work with a high degree of clinical autonomy while collaborating closely with an interdisciplinary care team and a dedicated Medical Director for support in complex cases. title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
description:
COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT) Contract terms: 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs Reports to: Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise) Summary The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world. Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation 's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need, while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation 's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem. We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities. This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s Communications Department, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise. Responsibilities 
 Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings. 
 Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers. 
 Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment. 
 Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning. 
 Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences. 
 Coordinate the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release. 
 Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar. 
 Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans. 
 Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals. 
 Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences. 
 Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders. 
 Skills and experience Required 
 At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line. 
 Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives. 
 Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms. 
 Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines. 
 Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations. 
 Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role. 
 Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents. 
 Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency. 
 A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data. 
 Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line reporting and leading through influence and collaboration. 
 Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets. 
 Experience overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies. 
 Preferred 
 Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, mission-driven, or community-governed organization, especially one with a commercial or earned-revenue arm. 
 Real understanding of AI, how it works, data licensing and content provenance debates 
 Familiarity with the Wikimedia movement, Wikipedia, or free-knowledge/open-content spaces. 
 Background in tech, media, or platform companies navigating AI-related content, licensing, or data issues. 
 About the Wikimedia Foundation 
 The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA. As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries * . For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process. title: Translator - US-Based Only
description:
About Prisma International, Inc. - Prisma is a dynamic and growing language services provider committed to delivering exceptional translation solutions to clients worldwide. We pride ourselves on our dedication to linguistic excellence and client satisfaction. We are expanding our independent contractor team and seeking experienced US-based Translators to join us. TRANSLATOR Job Posting - Prisma International We are seeking experienced, professional Translators to join our independent contractor team. You will be providing written translation from English into your native (target) language. To be considered for hire, you must meet all minimum requirements listed in this job ad. NOTE: Qualified candidates must reside in the United States and provide a three-year history of experience completing written translations to state and/or federal government agencies. Other minimum requirements are stated below. Translation project assignments are assigned on an as-needed basis according to your availability. TARGET LANGUAGES: Albanian, Amharic, Bosnian, Chuukese, Danish, Finnish, German, Haitian Creole, Hindi, Hmong, Italian, Japanese, Karen, Khmer, Korean, Laotian, Norwegian, Oromo, Portuguese (BR & PT), Somali, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Thai, Tibetan, Tigrinya, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese. I f your language specialty is not listed above, you are welcome to apply. You must meet all requirements to be considered. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - You must meet ALL of the following requirements: 
 You must reside in the United States. 
 You must be 18+ years of age. 
 Three (3) years of professional experience providing written translations to state and/or federal government agencies. The resume/CV you submit must clearly outline your government agency translation history. Candidates who submit resumes without a three-year timeline of fed/state government agency experience will be disqualified. 
 Certified by a translation industry organization such as: American Translators Association (ATA), Institute of Translation and Interpreting (ITI), Interagency Language Roundtable (ILR), etc. --OR-- a Bachelor's degree (or higher) in translation or other language-related discipline from an accredited college or university. If onboarded, you will be asked to submit proof of accreditation(s). Five+ years of professional translation services to state and/or federal government agencies may be accepted in lieu of the above. 
 Willingness to abide by Prisma's Master Service Agreement (MSA) and related Addenda. 
 Fluent in English and the target language. 
 Reliable desktop PC or laptop with dedicated, secure, high-speed internet connection. 
 Experience using modern CAT tools (e.g. XTM, Trados, etc.). 
 Adobe Acrobat on your device and the ability to use Adobe's markup tools on a PDF file. 
 TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Provide written translations using a Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tool. We provide XTM access to you. 
 Adhere to all project work instructions, glossaries and reference materials provided to you. 
 Ensure the source content's concept, style and register are culturally and linguistically appropriate for the target language. 
 Perform language quality check steps (before delivery) to ensure the target translation is error-free and true to the meaning of the source document. 
 Deliver completed translation jobs by the given deadlines and project budgets. 
 Review formatted target language PDF files for accuracy; mark any corrections needed. Using Adobe mark-up tools is required. 
 Communicate in a timely and professional manner with Prisma team members. 
 Willfully participate in quality management processes, e.g. Corrective Action Reports (CARs), Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), solution implementation. 
 Take all measures necessary to protect and keep private sensitive information shared with you to carry out translation projects (e.g. PHI, PII, SBU). 
 Adhere to policies and processes defined in Prisma's Master Service Agreement (MSA) and the Prisma Vendor Guide. 
 OTHER ATTRIBUTES 
 Excellent communication skills and quick responses to Prisma project team requests. 
 Ability to accommodate fast turnarounds for small word count projects. 
 After hours and weekend ability is a plus (at your discretion).
