title: Social Content & Growth Strategist
description:
Social Content & Growth Strategist Fully Remote Work From Home Role Compensation Based on Experience 
 Role 
 Our client is a comic and entertainment company looking for a hands on Social Content & Growth Strategist to help build audiences around their characters, stories, digital products, games, and upcoming entertainment projects. 
 This is not a traditional social media manager role. They need someone who can research what is working, generate original ideas, create content, direct a graphics team, publish, analyze results, and continually evolve the strategy. 
 You should be equally comfortable coming up with a meme, editing a Reel, researching why an account is suddenly growing, building next week’s content calendar, and looking at analytics to determine what to try next. 
 They are looking for someone curious, resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and deeply familiar with how internet culture and social platforms actually work today. 
 What You'll Do 
 Creative & Content 
 
 Develop original concepts for memes, static posts, carousels, short-form videos, character content, and recurring social series. 
 Turn concepts into finished, publishable content using the company’s existing artwork and assets. 
 Write strong captions, hooks, headlines, and short-form copy in distinct character voices. 
 Edit short-form videos and create social-first graphics. 
 Use AI-assisted creative tools intelligently while ensuring finished content feels intentional, polished, and human rather than generically AI-generated. 
 Identify opportunities to repurpose comics, animation, games, trailers, and other existing assets into social content. 
 
 Growth & Research 
 
 Constantly research emerging social formats, platform changes, algorithm behavior, creators, entertainment brands, fandoms, memes, and cultural trends. 
 Identify what’s driving growth for other accounts and translate those observations into experiments the team can run. 
 Develop strategies for reaching non-followers through shares, recommendations, collaborations, creators, trends, and other organic distribution. 
 Find relevant creators, communities, accounts, and potential collaborators. 
 Proactively bring new growth ideas to the team rather than waiting for assignments. 
 
 Publishing & Organization 
 
 Own and maintain the social content calendar. 
 Schedule and publish consistently across active accounts. 
 Keep assets, drafts, approvals, captions, and publishing schedules organized. 
 Coordinate with designers, animators, editors, and other team members for assets as needed. 
 Help manage multiple distinct social accounts. 
 
 Analytics & Experimentation 
 
 Track reach, non-follower reach, engagement, shares, saves, watch time, profile visits, follower growth, clicks, and other relevant metrics. 
 Identify which content and formats are actually driving discovery and audience growth. 
 Run small experiments, evaluate the results, and quickly iterate. 
 Provide simple, actionable reporting focused on what worked, what didn’t, why, and what should be done next. 
 As the company’s commerce ecosystem grows, help connect social performance to digital product sales, game engagement, email acquisition, and app growth. 
 
 What we're looking for 
 
 Strong understanding of Instagram/Meta and TikTok, particularly short-form content and organic discovery. 
 Demonstrated ability to personally create compelling social content , not simply manage other creators. 
 Strong copywriting instincts and a good sense of humor. 
 Fluency in memes, internet culture, entertainment, fandoms, creators, and emerging social trends. 
 Comfortable with Canva and/or Adobe tools, plus short-form video editing software. 
 Experience using modern AI creative tools is strongly preferred. 
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several content streams simultaneously. 
 Analytical enough to understand performance data without losing the creative instinct behind great content. 
 Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently. 
 Proactive — someone who brings ideas and opportunities to the team rather than needing a detailed assignment for every task. 
 
 Most importantly: The client is less interested in years of experience than in evidence that you understand how audiences grow today and can turn that understanding into actual content. Know how to learn. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Within the first few months, the client expects this person to help establish consistent publishing across their accounts, develop recognizable content formats for individual characters, improve non-follower reach and organic discovery, identify repeatable growth opportunities, and create a faster feedback loop between research → idea → content → performance → next experiment . 
 The larger goal is to turn the company’s social channels into an audience engine that supports its characters, digital products, games, original shows, and ultimately the broader company ecosystem. 
 Location 
 Remote 
 Availability 
 Part-Time (20h per week) 
 Must be available to collaborate during U.S. Pacific Time (PT) business hours Compensation Based on experience. Please indicate your desired hourly rate when submitting your application.

title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Product
description:
About Abridge Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients. Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. The Role Abridge’s in-house legal team is a group of lawyers and legal professionals operating across multiple disciplines. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a practical, versatile product lawyer to join our growing legal team. The right person can identify the legal issue quickly, learn the product deeply, and give the business a practical path forward. You will serve as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams, embedding legal and compliance frameworks into our product lifecycle. You will own matters independently and help turn recurring questions into clear guidance and durable systems that support innovation while ensuring compliance with healthcare, privacy, and other regulatory requirements. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of both AI and healthcare. What You’ll Do 
 Serve as a primary legal partner for our products and features from early design through launch and post-launch review. 
 Partner with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, policy, partner experience, marketing, IT, finance, corporate development, and commercial to ensure alignment and mitigate risk. 
 Review product launches, feature changes, user-facing disclosures, and marketing claims 
 Develop and scale practical legal processes, frameworks, and templates that enable teams to move quickly with appropriate guardrails 
 Provide actionable legal guidance on regulatory, privacy, and compliance matters, including the evolving AI/ML landscape. 
 Flex across the broader Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risk change. 
 Coordinate with external counsel to resolve specialist issues and ensure fast delivery of actionable legal guidance and risk analysis. 
 Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting Abridge’s products and data practices and advise internal stakeholders on their implications. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Passion for Abridge’s mission and the energy and drive to support fast-moving product and operational teams 
 5+ years of legal experience, including 3+ years in product counseling. Prior in-house experience at a technology company is a requirement. 
 Working knowledge of privacy and data protection, consumer protection, and intellectual property issues as they apply to technology products 
 Ability to spot issues across a broad range of legal areas, dig into unfamiliar regulatory questions, and know when to bring in specialist expertise 
 Proven ability to communicate and translate complex regulatory and legal concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-legal counterparts and colleagues. 
 Comfort and confidence with juggling a high volume of projects, tight timelines, and competing priorities. 
 Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise business judgement; interest in joining a small team that prioritizes autonomy and trust. 
 Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with technical teams, designers, and commercial teams, building relationships and earning their confidence. 
 Creativity in solving and navigating novel legal matters; experience in crafting new processes and language to meet the needs of a rapidly-moving enterprise in a novel industry. 
 Bonus Points If… 
 Expertise in intellectual property, AI, or software and technology transactions (e.g., licensing, open source) 
 Familiarity with recent trends in AI, particularly with large language models and responsible AI principles 
 Prior experience at a growth-stage, AI-native, or healthcare technology company 
 Strong understanding of and experience with federal and state healthcare laws, including HIPAA and state health privacy laws 
 Experience with healthcare regulatory matters, including FDA, FTC, fraud, waste, and abuse laws, health data interoperability and information blocking rules, and related state laws 
 This role is in San Francisco or New York City. Monday/Wednesday/Friday are in office days. Why Work at Abridge? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. How we take care of Abridgers: 
 Generous Time Off : 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees 
 Comprehensive Health Plans : Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families. 
 Generous HSA Contribution : If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA. 
 Paid Parental Leave : Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees. 
 Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family. 
 401(k) Matching : Contribution matching to help invest in your future. 
 Personal Device Allowance : Tax free funds for personal device usage. 
 Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits. 
 Lifestyle Wallet : Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more. 
 Mental Health Support : Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals. 
 Sabbatical Leave : Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment. 
 Compensation and Equity : Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees. 
 ... and much more! 
 Equal Opportunity Employer Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process. Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @ abridge .com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions. Compensation Range: $188K - $221K Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Backend developer
description:
OverIT at a glance OverIT is a global Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company with a strong presence in North America and Europe. We empower organizations in the power, utility, telco, and transportation industries to manage their mission-critical infrastructures efficiently and safely through cutting-edge Field Service Management software solutions. At OverIT , we leverage advanced technologies like ML (Machine Learning), AR (Augmented Reality), IoT (Internet of Things), and GIS (Geographic Information System) to help ensure the infrastructures essential to our daily lives are always on. If you want to be part of a top technology brand, join us! What you’ll do 
 Design and develop high-quality backend services and REST APIs primarily using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, treating the API surface as a product used by internal teams, partners, and system integrators — not just an internal implementation detail. 
 Own complex data models on Oracle, and design event-driven flows through Kafka, using Redis for caching, session state, and other performance-critical paths. 
 Implement OIDC-based authentication and build resource servers that correctly validate tokens, scopes, and claims. 
 Take ownership of modernizing legacy backend components: identify technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and scalability limitations, and propose sustainable evolution strategies — moving with confidence and speed without breaking what customers depend on today. 
 Publish and maintain internal libraries and shared modules other engineering teams rely on, managing versioning, breaking changes, and documentation with the same rigor as an external API. 
 Build automated test suites and quality gates as a default part of delivery, not an afterthought. 
 Promote secure-by-design principles and software quality standards across the development lifecycle. 
 Write and run integration tests, contract tests, and performance tests as a standard part of delivery — not just unit tests — and hold your API design and code linting to a consistently enforced standard. 
 Explore and apply AI-native engineering practices in your daily workflow — including agentic development tools and Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) practices — with a clear eye on token consumption and the judgment to know when to lean on AI assistance and when not to. 
 Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 What you’ll need 
 Solid experience in Software Engineering, with proven experience designing and implementing complex backend systems end to end. 
 Deep expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring Data, and Spring Security. 
 Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (or equivalent event-streaming/messaging systems) and Redis. 
 Deep knowledge of relational databases, ideally Oracle, including data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning for complex domains. 
 Practical, hands-on experience implementing OIDC and building resource servers — token validation, scopes, claims-based authorization. 
 A demonstrated track record of modernizing legacy backend systems with confidence and speed, not only building greenfield. 
 Strong knowledge of REST API design, versioning, and building APIs that partners and system integrators can build on without things breaking underneath them. 
 Genuine, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of your daily workflow — including a track record of leveraging modern LLM-assisted development, awareness of your own token consumption, and the judgment to know when the tools help and when they don't. 
 Strong, well-formed opinions on sticking to industry standards over reinventing the wheel. 
 Practical, hands-on experience writing and running integration tests, performance tests, and contract tests (e.g., Pact) and disciplined use of linting/code-quality tooling. 
 Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. 
 What’s nice to have 
 Application security experience beyond authentication — secure coding practices, threat modeling, dependency hygiene. 
 Performance engineering experience — profiling, load testing, tuning JVM, database, and cache layers under real production traffic. 
 Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (AWS, Kubernetes, containers) and modern DevOps practices. 
 Contributions to open-source projects or other significant personal technical achievements — a strong signal of genuine engineering craft. 
 Cloud, security, or software architecture certifications. 
 What we offer 
 
 OverIT is a unique transformation project in the SaaS space arena, full of ambition to scale and grow globally. 
 International culture and environment with the opportunity to partner with an outstanding group of people and professionals who joined the company to scale and succeed 
 A career-defining opportunity with full exposure to two leading private equity firms. 
 Location-flexible smart working across Italy 
 Competitive pay, meaningful growth opportunities, and a transparent approach to compensation. Salary ranges are defined for each role based on experience, competencies, responsibilities, and geographic location, with additional benefits and performance-based incentives depending on the position. 
 The expected annual gross salary range for this position is €40,000–€55,000. 
 At OverIT we value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, ethnicity, or place of origin. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Child & Community Impact Narrative & Data Specialist
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith. Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories! Key Responsibilities: 
 As the Child & Community Impact Data Specialist, you will define and drive the strategic evolution of World Vision ’s sponsorship impact intelligence ecosystem—shaping how child and community impact is translated into compelling, sponsor-facing engagement experiences globally. 
 You will lead the design and implementation of integrated impact intelligence frameworks that connect child sponsorship data, programme outcomes, and storytelling into scalable, AI-enabled engagement experiences across 30+ markets. 
 Working in close partnership with global marketers and internal systems teams, you will support sponsor engagement, acquisition, and retention by ensuring high-quality data, system readiness, and efficient, automated storytelling solutions. 
 This role plays a critical part in strengthening the sponsorship experience by ensuring it is grounded in credible, connected evidence of change—capturing the story of both the child and their community. 
 You will lead cross-functional collaboration to design, deliver, and continuously improve impact data frameworks that meet the needs of Support Offices, field teams, and sponsors worldwide, while advancing the transition from static reporting to dynamic, data-driven storytelling. 
 As part of a global team, you will help enable children and their communities to share their stories, while empowering sponsors to better understand and connect with the impact they help create. 
 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
 Strong experience in monitoring, data design, and impact storytelling —especially in development or humanitarian contexts. 
 
 A collaborative and systems-oriented mindset , with a proven ability to utilise emerging technology to automate processes and coordinate across diverse stakeholders and technical teams. 
 
 A passion for using data to communicate change , uplift voices, and connect supporters with meaningful progress in communities. 
 
 Design Impact Intelligence & Narrative Systems Lead the collaborative design of registered child (RC) and programmatic impact data based on customer insights, field innovation, and evolving Support Office requirements. Architect modular data-to-story frameworks and a transition roadmap from legacy processes to AI-enabled impact systems. Translate indicators into narrative building blocks. Enable AI-assisted storytelling pipelines and quality assurance of generated stories. 
 
 Coordinate Data Delivery Oversee the end-to-end process of collecting, validating, and delivering sponsor-ready impact data to ensure consistency, timeliness, and alignment with global standards. 
 
 Integrate Child & Community Data Co-develop a fully integrated approach to combine RC monitoring with programme activity monitoring—delivering a holistic ‘child in community’ impact narrative. 
 
 Drive Continuous Improvement Lead ongoing enhancements to data quality, systems, and delivery processes that promote simplification, performance, and deeper alignment with World Vision ’s programming work. 
 KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND EXPERIENCE 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, International Development, or equivalent. 
 7+ years’ experience in data transformation and/or automation, or data science, statistics, engineering, or mathematics. 
 Hands-on experience in developing end-to-end data pipelines or automating repetitive data tasks. 
 Strategic systems thinking across marketing and data ecosystems. 
 Experience leading enterprise-scale data, digital transformation, or impact intelligence initiatives across complex global organizations. 
 Demonstrated ability to define strategic frameworks and operationalize scalable global capabilities. 
 Proven success influencing senior stakeholders across technical, marketing, product, and operational functions. 
 Experience in prompt engineering for generative AI, AI output validation and risk mitigation, automated narrative systems, and business analytics. Proven experience applying AI/ML to real-world data products or content generation. 
 Experience translating data into emotionally compelling narratives via content strategy or digital storytelling. 
 Experience in working across cultures and within complex organizational structures. 
 Analytical skills, catalyst for improvement and innovation, problem-solving involving multiple disciplines. 
 High attention to detail, ability to work with technical experts and teams, as well as marketers, to achieve optimal results. 
 Flexible and willing to travel per World Vision policy. 
 Knowledge of Child Sponsorship and development programming, preferably with World Vision . 
 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 
 Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with proven experience in executive reporting and updates. 
 Skilled in stakeholder engagement across cultures, time zones, and organisational levels. 
 Highly proficient in Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Smartsheet. Desired: Any experience in Python, SQL, Bash/Shell scripting, Prefect, Luigi, dbt, or cloud services such as AWS. 
 Applicant Types Accepted: Local Applicants Only World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments. title: Commercial Lead
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Commercial Solutions team ensures operational and programmatic excellence across deal cycles, increases revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drives closure of Stripe’s sold portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as User feedback and market insights. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Commercial Solutions team, responsible for developing, launching, and maintaining commercial constructs and programs to drive revenue for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Stripe’s Global Business Services’ Commercial Solutions team is looking for a Commercial Lead to own the end-to-end programmatic development of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs that drive revenue for Stripe. Programs have a large scope and/or impact, including ownership of the development and support of first-of-their-kind commercialization efforts, ongoing program support (from pre-launch to post-launch), custom deal support related to the program, related enablement and communications, and acting as a change agent across the business.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and/or GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial programs, change management experience, and a strong understanding of and experience in scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You will have experience in program ownership and management, custom pricing strategies, and supporting selling motions. You will have strong communication skills and executive presence to effectively communicate with Stripes, from sellers and Deal Strategies through to senior leadership. You will love this job if you are a natural relationship and mechanism builder.

Responsibilities

Independently lead large-scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, often first-of-their-kind programs and initiatives.

Manage and lead highly complex programs that require considerable resources and high levels of functional and technical integration and knowledge.

Support the commercial program deal motion, partnering with Deal Pricing and/or Deal Strategy Strategists, sellers, and internal stakeholders to create custom commercial approaches.

Work cross-functionally with sales teams, sales leaders, services and support teams, product teams, and other cross-functional teams to develop, launch, and scale commercial programs, continuously evolving the ways Stripe goes to market to support commercialization efforts.

Identify, surface, and address systemic, broad issues and gaps, proposing holistic solutions to address root causes.

Work through complex programmatic problems at scale across go-to-market and Stripe, proposing creative solutions.

Partner with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Finance, Accounting, service teams, and product teams to resolve and remove internal blockers.

Act as a liaison among Sales, Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, and other stakeholders for custom elements.

Run meetings, working sessions, and exercises that help the leadership team improve effectiveness among themselves and across the organization.

Advocate on behalf of a position and quickly gain cross-functional alignment on that position.

Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders.

Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

BA/BS degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics.

10+ years of experience in program management, commercial strategy, economics, deal management, or pricing, including ownership of program strategy or business operations and direct experience in commercial pricing model program management, deal management, and/or oversight.

Experience driving cross-team mechanism development end to end, including ideation, planning, execution, launch, and post-launch support.

Experience working in ambiguous, quickly scaling environments, with a high degree of agency.

Experience engaging with senior executives on high-priority initiatives, as well as the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations.

Ability to articulate and understand business strategy at the C-suite level to gain credibility and advise organizations on how best to achieve their business goals through commercial programs.

Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and project management skills.

Ability to establish credibility and maintain working relationships with internal stakeholders involved with commercial constructs, including Legal, Finance, and Accounting.

Experience presenting data and metrics to senior leadership.

Strong ability to advocate for a position, even in the face of pushback.

Preferred qualifications

Direct commercial construct launch oversight and experience

Payments industry experience

MBA degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics

Possess PgMP or PMP certification

title: Clinical Strategy and Program Development Lead
description:

The Clinical Strategy and Program Development Lead develops and advances enterprise clinical strategies that improve healthcare quality, affordability, provider performance, and member outcomes. As part of the Clinical Performance Strategy & Measurement Team, this role identifies and evaluates high-impact opportunities, assesses performance gaps, and develops clinical performance frameworks and quality measures that enable the organization to define, track, and improve performance across the enterprise. Partnering across clinical, analytics, operations, network, and business teams, the Clinical Strategy and Program Development Lead translates complex data and insights into business cases, strategic recommendations, and investment priorities that drive measurable clinical and business value. The role operates within a strategy-to-execution model, helping move enterprise priorities from opportunity identification through implementation, measurement, adoption, and sustained impact. This position plays a key role in shaping Humana 's long-term clinical performance strategy by identifying emerging opportunities, developing strategic roadmaps, advancing innovative measurement approaches, and creating scalable solutions that deliver sustainable enterprise value. Clinical Strategy & Opportunity Development 
 Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve clinical performance across priority populations and specialties through data analysis, measurement gap assessment, and development of performance frameworks and quality measures. 
 Conduct strategic assessments of clinical performance and measurement gaps to identify improvement opportunities and advance enterprise priorities. 
 Conduct specialty landscape analyses and identify gaps in performance, measurement, and enterprise capabilities to inform future investment decisions. 
 Develop business cases, strategic recommendations, and adoption approaches for new clinical initiatives. 
 Develop and maintain strategic roadmaps that prioritize future clinical performance opportunities and align investments with enterprise objectives. 
 Own and maintain a pipeline of future clinical performance opportunities aligned to enterprise priorities. 
 Measurement & Performance Improvement 
 Develop clinical performance frameworks, quality measures, and measurement strategies to evaluate outcomes and drive improvement. 
 Partner with clinical, analytics, and business leaders to ensure performance measures align with organizational objectives and support meaningful action. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, establish success metrics, and evaluate results. 
 Support governance processes related to clinical performance measurement and prioritization. 
 Strategic Leadership & Collaboration 
 Build strong partnerships across clinical, operational, analytics, network, and business teams. 
 Present recommendations and influence executive decision-making. 
 Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve quality, cost, and member outcomes. 
 Innovation 
 Monitor industry trends and emerging best practices. 
 Identify opportunities to expand enterprise clinical capabilities and deliver long-term value. 
 
 Use your skills to make an impact 
 Role Essentials Bachelor's degree 8+ years of experience in healthcare strategy, clinical strategy, healthcare consulting, population health, provider performance, value-based care or quality improvement OR 4 years of experience from a top tier consulting Experience developing strategic recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data analysis Experience leading cross-functional strategic initiatives and driving results across multiple stakeholders Experience partnering with analytics teams to analyze healthcare data and generate actionable insights Experience developing business cases and presenting recommendations to senior leadership Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills Self-starter with the ability to proactively identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and manage competing priorities Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in a fast-paced environment Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Role Desirables Advanced degree (Master's or Doctorate) in Business (MBA), Public Health, Epidemiology, Healthcare Administration, Clinical Informatics, or a related field Experience developing business cases, strategic roadmaps, and enterprise-level recommendations for healthcare programs and initiatives 
 Clinical degree or licensure (e.g., MD, DO, PharmD, APRN, NP, PA, RN, BSN) 
 Knowledge of healthcare claims data, clinical coding systems and taxonomies (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), quality measurement methodologies, performance analytics, and their application to performance measurement and improvement initiatives

title: Systems Engineer Senior Principal - Infrastructure and Data Platforms
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger. Position Purpose: The Systems Engineer Sr. Principal is responsible for overseeing the development, maintenance and support of The Home Depot's technical infrastructure that includes network, hardware, database and system software components. Sr. Principals will help accelerate delivery speed and quality through technical expertise, technical leadership, and by communicating best practices within their assigned IT portfolios. They will be a key contact point across a large portfolio for sharing and engaging with principal software engineers to foster learning and adoption of new technologies. They will interface with our 3rd party vendors to ensure THD's technical needs are met and that we are driving interoperability within our existing technology landscape. The role will typically support 4-6 different teams (contrasted with 2-3 for a Principal and 6-10 for a Distinguished Engineer) which will span a variety of functioning products. They will ensure that teams are making good use of resources, designing and refactoring systems to optimize costs, and will be responsible for identifying opportunities to streamline processes and optimize current infrastructure. Key Responsibilities: 
 30% Delivery and Execution - Leads portfolio level Principal meetings to maintain alignment, consistency and knowledge sharing; Collaborates with other leaders to drive build versus buy decisions with regard to technology; Develops POCs with new technologies and paves the way for portfolio adoption; Tracks and monitors efficient usage of resources and drives cost reduction opportunities and enhancements 
 20% People - Acts as a point of escalation for teams facing extremely complex challenges; Provides leadership, mentoring, and coaching to direct reports and supported teams; Conducts and collaborates with team leaders on annual and mid-year reviews, reviewing individual development plans and providing performance feedback; Attracts, retains, develops, and motivates top talent; Is active in building associate connections to the broader technology community 
 30% Strategy and Planning - Works with Distinguished Engineer(s) to define technology solutions (open source or vendor) teams should be exploring and/or leveraging; Works across teams to unify strategy and alignment; Identifies and removes potential roadblocks & bottlenecks across large cross-functional projects and initiatives; Participates in and influences development of technology roadmaps within a given portfolio; Drives thought leadership and innovation within a given portfolio 
 20% Support and Enablement - Point of escalation for high-priority issues and outages as they arise; Fields questions from project, product, and support teams; Helps solve technology disputes across local teams; Works with vendors to help identify and implement feature enhancements in software products; Evangelizes successful usage of tooling and technology with local teams 
 Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

Physical Requirements: Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles. Working Conditions: Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 Platform tools and technologies, including Kubernetes and CNCF associated projects as well as familiarity with RedHat OpenShift and Pivotal Cloud Foundry. Experience with core data solutions including SQL Server and Oracle is a plus. Experience using AI-assisted development practices.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:

description:

title: Director, Financial Reporting & Internal Controls
description:
At Mitel , you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience. Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available. The Director, Financial Reporting & Internal Controls is responsible for the Company’s consolidated financial reporting, technical accounting, global statutory reporting and audit activities, and oversight of the internal control environment. This role will oversee a small team, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload prioritization and performance support while ensuring high-quality execution of key reporting and control deliverables. The role partners closely with senior finance leadership, regional finance teams, cross-functional stakeholders and external auditors. Key Responsibilities 
 Prepare the Company’s quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with IFRS. 
 Support quarterly and annual reporting processes and review significant accounting entries and adjustments. 
 Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial reporting across the organization. 
 Lead the consolidated financial statement audit, acting as the primary relationship manager with external auditors, coordinating key deliverables, reviewing and participating in the negotiation of audit fees, and resolving audit and accounting matters. 
 Serve as a key technical accounting resource and lead the assessment and documentation of complex and non-routine transactions under IFRS, including revenue recognition, share-based compensation, leases, pensions, restructuring and provisions, impairments, business combinations, legal entity restructuring and other complex accounting matters. 
 Monitor new accounting standards and developments and assess their impact on the Company’s financial reporting and accounting policies. 
 Oversee global statutory financial statements, audits and required filings across multiple jurisdictions, including managing the statutory audit calendar, coordinating with local finance teams, external auditors and service providers, monitoring progress and driving timely completion. 
 Oversee the financial internal control environment, including monitoring key controls, identifying control gaps and supporting remediation activities. 
 Partner with Tax, Treasury, Legal and other functions on significant transactions, restructurings and other accounting matters. 
 Support acquisitions, integrations, legal entity restructurings and other strategic initiatives from an accounting and financial reporting perspective. 
 Drive continuous improvement and standardization of financial reporting, statutory audit and related finance processes. 
 Lead, coach and develop a small team, including setting priorities, assigning work, providing timely feedback and supporting professional growth. 
 Promote a collaborative, high-performance team environment with clear expectations, effective communication and accountability for deliverables. 
 Support ad hoc projects and transactions as required. 
 Requirements 
 Must hold a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, ACA, or ACCA). 
 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, preferably including experience in a large multinational organization and/or public accounting. 
 Strong knowledge of IFRS. 
 Experience in preparing consolidated financial statements and related disclosures. 
 Strong technical accounting research and documentation skills. 
 Experience managing external audits and global statutory reporting requirements. 
 Experience working across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions and finance teams. 
 Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex accounting matters clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders. 
 Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, developing and managing the performance of direct reports in a finance or accounting environment. 
 Experience with SAP, BlackLine and financial consolidation/reporting systems is an asset.
